title: Gerente de Vendas de Área
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Gerente de Vendas de Área em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

O candidato ideal terá histórico comprovado em vendas de dispositivos médicos, especificamente em neurocirurgia, tecnologias de coluna vertebral ou craniana, e possuirá relacionamentos sólidos com os principais stakeholders em hospitais e centros cirúrgicos.


Localização : Brasil

Requisitos

  • Graduação em administração de empresas, ciências da vida ou área correlata (MBA será um diferencial).
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em vendas de dispositivos médicos, com no mínimo 3 anos em neurocirurgia/coluna vertebral/neurovascular.
  • Sucesso comprovado no mercado local; rede de clientes existente é preferível.
  • Fluência no idioma local e em inglês.
  • Excelentes habilidades de negociação, apresentação e construção de relacionamentos.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens com mais de 50% de frequência dentro da região.


Nossas Ofertas

  • Salário competitivo + bônus baseados em desempenho.
  • Crescimento de carreira em uma empresa global de tecnologia médica.
  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico com produtos inovadores.

Se Candidate Agora

Envie seu currículo vitae para com o assunto : Neurocirurgia-Brasil- (Seu Nome)

title: Country Manager- Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Country Manager- Brazil em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About VelaFi


At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we help businesses move money across borders faster, more securely, and more efficiently by connecting local banking rails, global payment networks, and leading stablecoin ecosystems through regulated entities across Latin America, Asia, and the United States.


Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability.


Position Overview

VelaFi is seeking an experienced Chief Executive Officer (CEO) – Brazil to lead the company's Brazilian operations and serve as the statutory executive responsible for the local VASP entity.

Reporting directly to the Global Executive Leadership Team, the CEO will be responsible for the overall leadership, strategic direction, regulatory engagement, commercial growth, and operational performance of VelaFi Brazil. This individual will play a critical role in establishing the company's presence in Brazil, leading local market expansion, fostering relationships with regulators and financial institutions, and ensuring compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements.


The ideal candidate combines executive leadership experience, strong commercial acumen, operational excellence, and the ability to lead a highly regulated financial services organization in a fast-growing global fintech environment. The CEO will also play a pivotal role in leading VelaFi Brazil's regulatory establishment, including executive oversight of the BACEN registration process and collaboration on the company's Brazil VASP licensing process, working closely with Compliance, Legal, and global leadership.


Location

Remote – Brazil

Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required.


Key Responsibilities

Executive Leadership

  • Lead the overall strategy, growth, and operational performance of VelaFi Brazil.
  • Build and develop the local leadership team and organizational structure.
  • Establish operational excellence while ensuring alignment with global company objectives.
  • Drive execution across Commercial, Operations, Finance, Compliance, and Product functions.

Regulatory & Corporate Governance

  • Serve as the primary executive representative before Brazilian regulatory authorities.
  • Maintain strong relationships with the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN) , financial institutions, banking partners, and other regulatory stakeholders.
  • Lead the company's BACEN registration process, ensuring timely execution of regulatory requirements and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Provide executive oversight and collaborate closely with Compliance, Legal, and global leadership throughout the Brazil VASP licensing process, supporting regulatory submissions, licensing milestones, and ongoing compliance efforts.
  • Ensure ongoing compliance with applicable VASP, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.
  • Support ongoing regulatory reporting, licensing renewals, and corporate governance initiatives.

Commercial Growth & Strategic Partnerships

  • Develop and execute the company's go-to-market strategy in Brazil.
  • Build strategic partnerships with banks, payment service providers (PSPs), fintechs, enterprise customers, and ecosystem partners.
  • Identify new business opportunities and support revenue growth.
  • Represent VelaFi at executive meetings, conferences, and industry events.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with Finance, Compliance, Treasury, Product, Operations, Legal, and Commercial teams.
  • Foster collaboration across global teams located in LATAM, APAC, and North America.
  • Drive organizational alignment and operational efficiency across all business functions.

Organizational Development

  • Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing teams.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Support workforce planning and organizational scaling as the business grows.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Law, or a related field.
  • MBA or other advanced degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of executive leadership experience within fintech, banking, payments, financial services, or related industries.
  • Proven experience leading business operations and organizational growth.
  • Strong understanding of Brazil's financial services and regulatory environment.
  • Experience working with regulators, banking institutions, and executive stakeholders.
  • Experience leading or supporting regulatory licensing, authorization, or registration processes with Brazilian financial regulators (including BACEN or VASP frameworks) is strongly preferred.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and decision-making skills.
  • Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English.


Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, payments, digital assets, stablecoins, or blockchain technology.
  • Experience launching or scaling financial services businesses in Brazil.
  • Existing relationships with Brazilian regulators, financial institutions, and payment providers.
  • Experience working within multinational or global organizations.
  • Experience with cross-border payments and treasury infrastructure.
  • Experience leading or supporting BACEN registration, financial institution licensing, or Brazil VASP authorization initiatives.


Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP)

Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including:

  • Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil.
  • Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities.
  • Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence.
  • Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws.
  • Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment.


Why Join VelaFi?

At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we connect local banking rails, global payment networks, and digital asset infrastructure to enable faster, more secure, and more efficient cross-border money movement.

Joining VelaFi means playing a foundational leadership role in establishing our regulated presence in Brazil while helping shape one of the company's most strategic growth markets. You'll work alongside global executive leadership to build a scalable business, lead critical regulatory initiatives, and help create the financial infrastructure powering the next generation of global payments.


Guided by our values of Ingenuity, Accountability, Excellence, Care, and a Global Mindset , we empower our leaders to solve meaningful challenges, take ownership, and build lasting impact across global financial markets.


Equal Employment Opportunity

VelaFi is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: SAP Solution Architect (Basis / Hyperscaler)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para SAP Solution Architect (Basis / Hyperscaler) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Na NTT DATA Business Solutions, impulsionamos a inovação – desde consultoria e implementação até serviços gerenciados e além, impulsionados por uma equipe global e mais de 18.500 especialistas representando mais de 90 nações em mais de 30 países. Com a SAP no nosso núcleo e um poderoso ecossistema de parceiros como Microsoft e ServiceNow, continuamos aprimorando soluções e tecnologias baseadas em IA para que funcionem para as empresas e para suas pessoas.


Conosco, você tem infinitas oportunidades para pensar grande, agir com ousadia e assumir a responsabilidade. Faça deste o lugar onde você pertence, aprende e constrói sua rede.


Make this the place where you grow!


Buscamos um(a) SAP Solution Architect com sólida experiência técnica em SAP Basis, certificação SAP PCA e atuação como especialista em arquiteturas SAP em ambientes hyperscaler certificados, para apoiar projetos estratégicos de System Move, Migration e Upgrades, além de iniciativas de pré‑vendas. Esse profissional será responsável por definir, validar e governar arquiteturas técnicas SAP em ambientes on‑premise, cloud e híbridos, assegurando viabilidade técnica, segurança, performance, escalabilidade e total aderência às melhores práticas e recomendações oficiais da SAP.


Principais Responsabilidades:



  • Definir e desenhar arquiteturas técnicas SAP para projetos de:
  • System Move (on‑premise ↔ cloud / datacenter); System Migration (ECC para S/4HANA, conversões técnicas e transformações de landscape); Upgrades SAP (tecnológicos e funcionais).
  • Atuar como especialista em arquiteturas SAP em hyperscalers certificados SAP, garantindo conformidade com padrões de:
  • Disponibilidade; Segurança; Performance; Escalabilidade.
  • Exercer o papel de arquiteto técnico e referência SAP Basis em projetos SAP de média e alta complexidade.
  • Apoiar processos de pré‑vendas, incluindo:
  • Análise de requisitos técnicos; Definição da arquitetura de solução;
  • Avaliação de riscos, premissas e dependências técnicas; Estimativas de esforço e definição da abordagem técnica;
  • Participação em reuniões com clientes e apresentações executivas.
  • Avaliar impactos técnicos relacionados a:
  • Migração e saneamento de dados;
  • Integrações SAP e sistemas legados;
  • Performance, alta disponibilidade, segurança e continuidade operacional.
  • Garantir aderência às boas práticas SAP, recomendações oficiais e padrões corporativos de arquitetura.
  • Apoiar equipes funcionais e técnicas na tomada de decisões arquiteturais ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida dos projetos.


Requisitos:


  • Certificação SAP PCA (perfil SAP Basis).
  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de Move, Migration e Upgrades SAP.
  • Atuação como especialista em arquiteturas SAP em hyperscalers certificados SAP.
  • Conhecimento sólido em: SAP S/4HANA; Arquitetura SAP on‑premise, cloud e híbrida; Ambientes hyperscaler certificados SAP; Integrações SAP; Landscapes SAP, governança técnica e migração de dados.
  • Forte capacidade de análise, identificação e mitigação de riscos técnicos.


Diferenciais:


  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com habilidade para interação com públicos técnicos e executivos.
  • Perfil consultivo, com visão end‑to‑end e forte orientação à solução.
  • Experiência prévia em pré‑vendas SAP.
  • Vivência em projetos SAP de grande porte e ambientes críticos.
  • Experiência em apresentações executivas e condução de workshops técnicos.



Regime de Contratação: Modelo de CLT

Remoto com disponibilidade de viagens

title: Senior GCP QA Auditor - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior GCP QA Auditor - Brazil em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior GCP QA Auditor – Full Time – Permanent – Remote – South America

At Zigzag, you will become a pivotal member of our team, working alongside industry leading experts and delivering our client’s quality assurance aspirations and outcomes.


**Please submit your CV in English**


What we are looking for

  • Extensive auditing experience in GCP. Thorough knowledge of GCP.
  • Additional knowledge of another GxP areas (GLP, GCLP, GMP, CSV, PV) would be advantageous.
  • Able to confidently audit Investigator Sites with limited oversight.
  • Life science degree.
  • Strong client focus.


What Zigzag has to offer you

  • Leading Quality Assurance consultancy company – Our auditors work internationally across different types of organizations and audits and other QA related projects, with top thought-leaders in the industry. We are committed to continuous professional development.
  • Fostering Success in our Auditors - Scheduling to ensure you are able to deliver your best, every time.
  • A Truly Supportive and Management Team – Having a supportive and open leadership team allows our people to show up and be their best.
  • WiZe working schedule - Flexible working schedule to allow you to live your life around work.
  • A Competitive Compensation Package – We believe our people need to be compensated for their dedication.
  • Sustainability – We endeavour to keep auditors travel as local as possible to reduce our carbon footprint in line with our sustainability policy as well as ensuring you have a work/life balance.


What You’ll Do With Us

Auditors target will be to work to 70% utilisation, which could require up to 50% travel to client sites, that doesn’t mean you’ll be away from home for months at a time, as we ensure we schedule assignments for a fair work/life balance.


Our auditors are deployed to audit Investigator Sites and Vendors, as well as eTMF audits which are done remotely.


You’ll support our clients with Inspection Readiness and Inspection Management related activities across a diverse range of roles and regulatory bodies.


Who We Are

ZigZagQA is a trusted global leader in QA management, offering true global reach and unrivalled expertise to reduce risk and efforts. Working as an extension of our clients team, our experts increase capability and efficiency with collaborative, comprehensive and customized QA programs.


We partners with a wide range of clients across the entire drug discovery and development process to improve GxP Quality against global regulatory standards. We work with top 20 Pharmaceutical and Biotechnology companies, all the way to startups.


We strive for excellence, aiming to be the number one choice for our clients and our employees. We are passionate about Continuous Improvement and are always looking for a ‘better way’.

We are a global, quality leader who put people first and forge lasting relationships to bring deep impact in the industry.

title: Contracting Manager, Activities Bank, Travel Industry
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Contracting Manager, Activities Bank, Travel Industry em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Contract Manager – Activities


About Us

At HBX Group , we are a global TravelTech ecosystem connecting and empowering businesses across the world of travel. Through data, innovation, and strong partnerships, we deliver seamless experiences and help our partners grow.

Within our Activities division, we focus on building competitive, high-quality product portfolios that meet evolving market demands. Our teams operate in a fast-paced, data-driven environment where ownership, adaptability, and collaboration are key to success.


Job Summary

As a Contract Manager , you will be responsible for managing and optimizing a portfolio of suppliers, ensuring the product remains competitive, available, and aligned with market needs.

This role combines supplier relationship management, negotiation, reporting, and operational execution , with a strong focus on performance tracking, prioritization, and continuous improvement . You will work closely with internal teams and external partners to drive revenue, maintain product quality, and unlock growth opportunities.


Job Responsibilities

Supplier & Portfolio Management

  • Manage a portfolio of Activities suppliers, ensuring product availability and competitiveness at all times.
  • Maintain and develop strong relationships with suppliers, acting as the main point of contact.
  • Ensure existing products remain optimized and aligned with market expectations.


Contracting & Negotiation

  • Negotiate commercial conditions including rates, inventory, offers, and contract terms.
  • Ensure renewal contracts are competitive and available in time to capture demand.
  • Benchmark competitors and proactively renegotiate where needed to maintain market positioning.


Performance Analysis & Reporting

  • Analyze portfolio performance through bi-weekly reports and statistics , identifying trends and opportunities.
  • Monitor KPIs and take actions to improve conversion, revenue, and product performance.
  • Provide insights and explanations on portfolio performance using data and market knowledge.


Operational Excellence

  • Manage multiple processes simultaneously, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and quality.
  • Prioritize tasks effectively based on business impact and deadlines.
  • Maintain updated product content (rates, inclusions, descriptions, availability).
  • Solve operational issues and coordinate solutions with internal teams and suppliers.


Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Work closely with internal stakeholders (Sales, Operations, Revenue, Product teams).
  • Support cross-functional initiatives and ensure alignment on commercial priorities.
  • Represent HBX Group in supplier meetings and market visits.


Required Skills

  • Strong prioritization and time management , with the ability to manage multiple processes simultaneously.
  • High level of analytical thinking , comfortable working with reports, data, and performance metrics.
  • Strong commercial mindset with negotiation capabilities.
  • Excellent relationship management and communication skills .
  • High attention to detail and process discipline, with flexibility to manage changing priorities.
  • Problem-solving mindset and ability to work independently.


Required Tech Skills

  • Intermediate Excel skills (data analysis, reporting, tracking KPIs).
  • Experience working with internal systems, contracting tools, or booking platforms .
  • Ability to analyze data and translate insights into actions.
  • Familiarity with reporting tools and dashboards is a plus.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 1–3+ years of experience in contracting, sourcing, account management, or similar roles.
  • Experience in travel, tourism, or supplier management is highly preferred.
  • Fluent in English, Spanish and Portuguese for communication with global teams.
  • Availability to travel as part of supplier relationship management.


At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference

Senior GCP QA Auditor – Full Time – Permanent – Remote – South America

At Zigzag, you will become a pivotal member of our team, working alongside industry leading experts and delivering our client’s quality assurance aspirations and outcomes.


**Please submit your CV in English**


What we are looking for

  • Extensive auditing experience in GCP. Thorough knowledge of GCP.
  • Additional knowledge of another GxP areas (GLP, GCLP, GMP, CSV, PV) would be advantageous.
  • Able to confidently audit Investigator Sites with limited oversight.
  • Life science degree.
  • Strong client focus.


What Zigzag has to offer you

  • Leading Quality Assurance consultancy company – Our auditors work internationally across different types of organizations and audits and other QA related projects, with top thought-leaders in the industry. We are committed to continuous professional development.
  • Fostering Success in our Auditors - Scheduling to ensure you are able to deliver your best, every time.
  • A Truly Supportive and Management Team – Having a supportive and open leadership team allows our people to show up and be their best.
  • WiZe working schedule - Flexible working schedule to allow you to live your life around work.
  • A Competitive Compensation Package – We believe our people need to be compensated for their dedication.
  • Sustainability – We endeavour to keep auditors travel as local as possible to reduce our carbon footprint in line with our sustainability policy as well as ensuring you have a work/life balance.


What You’ll Do With Us

Auditors target will be to work to 70% utilisation, which could require up to 50% travel to client sites, that doesn’t mean you’ll be away from home for months at a time, as we ensure we schedule assignments for a fair work/life balance.


Our auditors are deployed to audit Investigator Sites and Vendors, as well as eTMF audits which are done remotely.


You’ll support our clients with Inspection Readiness and Inspection Management related activities across a diverse range of roles and regulatory bodies.


Who We Are

ZigZagQA is a trusted global leader in QA management, offering true global reach and unrivalled expertise to reduce risk and efforts. Working as an extension of our clients team, our experts increase capability and efficiency with collaborative, comprehensive and customized QA programs.


We partners with a wide range of clients across the entire drug discovery and development process to improve GxP Quality against global regulatory standards. We work with top 20 Pharmaceutical and Biotechnology companies, all the way to startups.


We strive for excellence, aiming to be the number one choice for our clients and our employees. We are passionate about Continuous Improvement and are always looking for a ‘better way’.

We are a global, quality leader who put people first and forge lasting relationships to bring deep impact in the industry.

title: Coordenador(a) de Customer Experience
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Coordenador(a) de Customer Experience em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

COORDENADOR(A) DE CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE | VIVÊNCIA DO ALUNO


Essa posição é para atuar na Ânima Holding , que faz parte do Ecossistema Ânima, o maior e o mais inovador ecossistema de ensino de qualidade do país, com instituições espalhadas por todo o Brasil. Somos uma empresa em constante evolução, que enxerga em cada detalhe novas formas de promover a educação. Por sinal, essa é a essência que nos faz ser diferentes.

Confira mais sobre a nossa oportunidade.


Do que você precisa para concorrer à vaga:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Comunicação, Marketing ou áreas correlatas; Pós-graduação ou Especialização em Gestão de Negócios, Customer Experience, Customer Success, Business Process Management (BPM), Business Intelligence ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência em Customer Experience (CX) e/ou Customer Success (CS); Vivência em liderança e desenvolvimento de equipes. Gestão de projetos, melhoria contínua de processos e implementação de iniciativas estratégicas. Análise de indicadores e tomada de decisão orientada por dados.
  • Perfil comportamental com boa comunicação, capacidade de negociação e articulação entre diferentes áreas; Perfil analítico, organizado, colaborativo e orientado para resultados.


Como será seu dia a dia como educador(a):

  • Liderar o time de Customer Experience (Vivência Incrível), promovendo o desenvolvimento técnico, analítico e estratégico da equipe;
  • Mapear, analisar e evoluir a jornada dos alunos, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e redução de atritos ao longo da experiência acadêmica;
  • Planejar, implementar e acompanhar iniciativas que promovam uma experiência cada vez mais fluida, integrada e encantadora para os estudantes;
  • Construir estratégias que fortaleçam o sentimento de pertencimento, satisfação e permanência dos alunos;
  • Monitorar indicadores de negócio e de experiência, propondo planos de ação baseados em dados;
  • Disseminar a cultura data-driven, incentivando decisões orientadas por evidências e indicadores;
  • Fortalecer a cultura de \"Aluno no Centro\", garantindo que a experiência do estudante seja considerada nas decisões corporativas;
  • Atuar em parceria com as áreas de Tecnologia, Operações, Atendimento, Marketing e demais áreas estratégicas para implementar melhorias na jornada dos alunos;
  • Desenvolver estudos, análises e apresentações executivas para apoiar decisões estratégicas;
  • Monitorar tendências e benchmarks de mercado em Customer Experience, propondo soluções inovadoras para evolução contínua da área;
  • Liderar projetos corporativos voltados à melhoria da experiência dos alunos, acompanhando indicadores e resultados das iniciativas implementadas.


Conhecimentos necessários para esta posição:

  • Domínio em Customer Experience (CX) e Customer Success (CS);
  • Gestão de projetos e metodologias para condução de iniciativas estratégicas;
  • Análise de dados, indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e cultura data-driven;
  • Ferramentas de CRM e gestão do relacionamento com clientes;
  • Inglês em nível intermediário.
  • Excel em nível avançado;
  • Mapeamento e gestão da jornada do cliente;
  • Conhecimento em Design de Serviços, Business Intelligence (BI) e Gestão de Processos (BPM);


Modalidade de atuação e horário de trabalho

  • Remoto - de segunda a quinta, das 8h30 às 18h30, e sexta, das 8h30 às 17h30, com 1h de intervalo.

Veja o que já vai encontrar no nosso Ecossistema Ânima

  • Bolsas de Estudos;
  • Indicação de 2 Bolsas de Estudos para quem preferir;
  • Programa de Bem-estar e Qualidade de Vida;
  • TotalPass;
  • Zenklub;
  • ECOA – Escola Corporativa Ânima, com mais de 100 cursos livres e gratuitos;
  • Day Off no aniversário;
  • Abono de meio período no aniversário do(a) filho(a) de até 16 anos;
  • Programa Valor das Pessoas: vale-presente para os educadores em momentos especiais da vida, como casamento, nascimento de filhos e novas titulações;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica.


Ah! Independente de cor, idade, gênero, orientação sexual, origem, religião ou qualquer outra característica, o que realmente importa para nós é a vontade de transformar vidas por meio da educação.


Seja um educador ou educadora no Ecossistema Ânima e venha transformar o país pela educação.

Boa sorte!

title: Rubber Engineers, Tyre Industries
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Rubber Engineers, Tyre Industries em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Company Description

SUNSET TIRES CORPORATION LIMITED, established on July 18th, 1988, has a rich legacy in the import, export, and distribution of tires, tubes, wheels, and lubricants. Known for its commitment to quality and service, the company is a trusted leader in the tire industry. SUNSET TIRES has built a strong reputation by delivering premium products to clients worldwide, emphasizing reliability and innovation.

This is a contract, remote role for Rubber Engineers specializing in the tire industry. Key responsibilities include designing, developing, and testing tire rubber formulations, ensuring quality and performance standards, analyzing raw materials, and modifying processes to meet client requirements. The role also involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to optimize product performance and manufacturing efficiency.

Qualifications
  • Expertise in Rubber Engineering, Polymer Science, and Material Development
  • Strong knowledge of tire rubber formulations and testing methodologies
  • Experience in technical analysis and process optimization
  • Proficiency in industry-standard software and equipment for rubber testing and development
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for reporting and cross-functional collaboration
  • Bachelor’s or higher degree in Polymer Engineering, Material Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related field
  • Experience in the tire or rubber industry is highly preferred

title: DGB Americas Training Manager South Latam
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para DGB Americas Training Manager South Latam em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

DGB Americas Training Manager – South LATAM

DOLCE & GABBANA Beauty

Location : Brazil

Reporting to: Education Senior Manager


Role Mission

We are seeking a dynamic, strategic, and hands-on Training Manager to lead all education initiatives across South LATAM. This individual will be responsible for elevating brand knowledge, retail excellence, and client experience across Fragrance, Makeup, and Skincare categories

The role acts as the regional guardian of training excellence, ensuring that all distributor and travel retail markets are aligned with global brand standards while adapting programs to local needs. This person will not only execute training programs but also build long-term capabilities within distributor teams, driving sell-out performance and brand desirability in the region.


Key Responsibilities

1. Regional Training Strategy & Execution

  • Own and execute the education strategy across South LATAM distributors and TR markets for fragrance, makeup, and skincare categories.
  • Adapt global training materials into impactful, locally relevant training modules (in-person and digital).
  • Develop and manage the regional training calendar, ensuring alignment with product launches and commercial priorities.
  • Deliver high-quality training across key markets, ensuring consistency and excellence in execution.
  • Manage the training budget for the region, ensuring efficient allocation of resources aligned with business priorities.
  • Partner and maintain close communication with Fashion boutique teams to execute training initiatives, ensuring alignment with brand standards and elevating client experience.


2. Distributor Partnership & Capability Building

  • Act as the main education liaison for distributors across South LATAM.
  • Train and coach local trainers and retail teams to ensure scalable knowledge transfer.
  • Track training effectiveness through KPIs (sell-out, engagement, certification rates) and implement improvements.
  • Tailor training approaches based on market maturity, cultural nuances, and business needs.


3. Brand & Product Expertise

  • Serve as the regional expert across fragrance, makeup, and skincare, ensuring deep product and brand storytelling knowledge.
  • Lead all training-related aspects of product launches, ensuring teams are fully prepared prior to market activation.
  • Elevate in-store execution standards through coaching on client experience, selling techniques, and service rituals.


4. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Sales and Marketing teams to align training initiatives with business objectives and sell-out targets.
  • Collaborate with Communications, Digital, and Trade Marketing teams to ensure a consistent brand message across all touchpoints.
  • Maintain alignment with brand DNA and guidelines.


5. Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Drive adoption of digital learning platforms and hybrid training formats (virtual, e-learning, etc.).
  • Identify and share best-in-class training practices across markets to elevate regional performance.
  • Gather feedback from the field to continuously refine training content and approach.


Requirements & Skills

  • 5+ years in Training/Education within the beauty industry (fragrance, makeup, and skincare preferred).
  • Strong understanding of LATAM markets
  • Proven ability to design and deliver engaging training programs to diverse audiences.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and influence different stakeholders.
  • Solid understanding of retail environments, client experience, and sales drivers.
  • Fluent in English, Spanish and Portuguese .
  • Willingness to travel frequently across South LATAM

We’re hiring: Social Lead / Social Media & Community Manager

Earned Media Productions (EMP) is looking for someone who can turn podcasts into growth engines — and build engaged communities around them.

This role sits at the intersection of content distribution, social strategy, and audience engagement.


What you’ll do:

description:

Role Overview

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.


Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers
  • Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)
  • Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)


Market & Network Development

  • Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa)
  • Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape


Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality
  • Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships


Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations
  • Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement


Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners
  • Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets
  • Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics
  • Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM


Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Vacation Rental Revenue Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Vacation Rental Revenue Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're hiring a detail-oriented, numbers-driven Vacation Rental Revenue Manager to help Emperor Rentals improve pricing, occupancy, and revenue across our short-term rental portfolio.


This is a fully remote position for candidates currently based in Brazil. You'll work with property performance data, market trends, and pricing tools to help us make smarter revenue decisions every week.


Compensation:

$250 USD per week, paid weekly.


What you'll do:

- Review property performance, pricing, occupancy, ADR, and revenue trends

- Help optimize nightly rates based on seasonality, demand, events, and competitor pricing

- Build and maintain simple revenue reports and forecasts

- Track KPIs and identify opportunities to increase profitability

- Support pricing decisions across Airbnb, short-term rental, and vacation rental channels

- Communicate insights clearly and help the team make data-backed decisions


You may be a great fit if you:

- Are currently based in Brazil and can work remotely

- Are highly analytical, organized, and comfortable working with numbers

- Have strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

- Can spot patterns in data and turn them into practical recommendations

- Are detail-oriented, reliable, and proactive

- Communicate clearly and can work independently

- Are interested in hospitality, Airbnb, short-term rentals, real estate, finance, or revenue management


Nice to have:

- Experience with Airbnb, vacation rentals, hotels, property management, or revenue management

- Experience with pricing tools, market research, dashboards, or financial reporting

- Background in business, finance, economics, analytics, hospitality, or a related field


This role is ideal for someone who enjoys data, pricing strategy, and helping a growing vacation rental company make smarter decisions. If you're based in Brazil and want a remote role where your analysis directly affects business results, we'd love to hear from you.


To apply, please include:

- Your resume

- A short note about your relevant experience

- Your LinkedIn profile, if available

Atuando como referência técnica, garante que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e alinhadas às necessidades do negócio, transformando dados em insights acionáveis para decisões estratégicas.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver, orquestrar e otimizar pipelines de dados com Databricks (PySpark, Spark SQL, Delta Lake e SQL Server)
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines robustos de ETL/ELT (SSIS e outras ferramentas)

  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de Big Data em ambientes cloud (principalmente Microsoft Azure)
  • Garantir governança, qualidade e segurança dos dados
  • Automatizar processos de carga e replicação de dados, incluindo cenários em tempo real
  • Colaborar com equipes de ciência de dados e negócio como referência técnica


✅ Requisitos:

  • Experiência mínima de 6 anos em Engenharia de Dados ou BI
  • Experiência prática com Databricks
  • Experiência com Data Marts / BW
  • Conhecimento avançado em SQL e modelagem de dados
  • Experiência com ETL (SSIS, Azure Data Factory ou Synapse Pipelines)
  • Experiência com Azure (Data Lake, Synapse, Azure SQL)
  • Programação em Python aplicada a dados
  • Ensino superior completo em áreas de tecnologia

title: Head of Compliance (Brazil resident)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Compliance (Brazil resident) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the company

We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet.


Why this role

We are entering the Brazilian market as a Banco Central do Brasil-authorised Virtual Asset Service Provider, and you would be our first Head of Compliance on the ground. The authorisation itself depends on having someone the BCB trusts in this seat — someone who treats AML/CFT, KYC, and disclosure as the actual job, not paperwork around it. In your first year, you will have stood up the compliance program the regulator expects to see and built the company's track record with the BCB from zero.


What you'll do

  • Hold statutory officer responsibility for compliance at a BCB-authorised VASP, with personal accountability for acting in good faith and in the company's best interest
  • Own the design and effectiveness of the AML/CFT and KYC program, including transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, and suspicious activity reporting
  • Act as the primary point of contact with the BCB and COAF for compliance matters, including audits, inspections, and ad hoc information requests
  • Maintain personal fitness and propriety; disclose, without prompting, anything that touches your fitness, propriety, or potential conflicts — to the company and to the BCB
  • Drive the VASP authorisation process forward on the compliance workstream, including declarations and documentation the BCB requests on its own timeline


What you'll bring

Must-have

  • Brazilian permanent residency or citizenship, with the ability to maintain ordinary residency in Brazil for as long as the role requires
  • You hold no competing officer or director seat at another regulated entity in Brazil
  • Direct compliance experience at a BCB-regulated institution (bank, securities broker/distributor, foreign exchange dealer) or at a crypto exchange/VASP
  • Hands-on ownership of AML/CFT and KYC programs, not just oversight of someone else's
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, written and spoken
  • Willing to undergo a full BCB fit-and-proper review and disclose what it requires


Nice-to-have

  • Prior compliance experience specifically within a crypto exchange or VASP
  • AML/compliance certification (e.g. CAMS, ICA)
  • Direct prior engagement with BCB or COAF on audits, inspections, or filings

title: Presales Solution Architect, OSS
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Presales Solution Architect, OSS em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Responsibilities:

  • Act as the lead OSS solution architect across the full pre-sales lifecycle – from opportunity qualification and technical discovery through proof-of-concept, proposal, and contract award – partnering closely with Sales leadership to shape, qualify, and grow the regional pipeline.
  • Own and orchestrate end-to-end responses to RFx (RFI / RFP / RFQ), including solution design, compliance and traceability matrices, win themes, technical narratives, effort and Bill-of-Materials estimation, assumptions, and risk identification – driving on-time, high-quality, fully compliant submissions.
  • Design and articulate end-to-end OSS solution architectures spanning Service Assurance, Service Orchestration & Fulfilment, Inventory, and closed-loop automation, mapping the Rakuten Symphony portfolio to operator pain points and measurable business outcomes.
  • Position and demonstrate the Service Assurance portfolio – fault, performance, and service-quality management; AI/ML-driven anomaly detection, alarm correlation and noise reduction; automated root-cause analysis; and predictive, proactive assurance – including customer-experience and network-slice assurance for 5G Standalone.
  • Develop solutions, value cases, and demonstrations around SMO (Service Management & Orchestration) and RIC (RAN Intelligent Controller) platforms, including the Non-RT RIC and rApps (R1, A1 interfaces) and the Near-RT RIC and xApps (E2 interface), addressing use cases such as RAN energy savings, traffic steering, QoE optimization, massive-MIMO and interference management, and anomaly detection.
  • Champion network automation and autonomy – closed-loop operations, intent-based and intent-driven management, and the journey toward TM Forum Level 4 autonomous networks – and translate these capabilities into concrete, quantifiable value propositions for customers.
  • Lead technical proofs-of-concept, lab trials, product demonstrations, and solution integration and validation, tailoring demo environments to each customer’s specific use cases, KPIs, and success criteria.
  • Be responsible and accountable for authoring technical solution documents, high-level designs, design proposals, sizing and Bill-of-Materials, and TCO / ROI models that withstand customer and third-party technical scrutiny.
  • Serve as the trusted technical advisor to customers and prospects – running discovery workshops, executive briefings, and technical deep-dives – and manage technical stakeholder relationships from engineering and operations teams up to C-level.
  • Work cross-functionally with internal teams – Product Management, Engineering, Delivery / Professional Services, Commercial, and Bid Management – and with external parties – operators, system integrators, hyperscalers, and O-RAN / ecosystem partners – to assemble winning and deliverable solutions.
  • Generate thought-leadership content – white papers, blogs, reference architectures, and webinars – and represent Rakuten Symphony at industry events and standards / community forums such as TM Forum and the O-RAN ALLIANCE.
  • Stay ahead of telecom market trends – Open RAN, 5G and 5G-Advanced, cloud-native CNFs and Kubernetes, observability and telemetry, GenAI and agentic AI for operations, and the shift toward data-driven, autonomous networks – and bring that insight into customer conversations and internal strategy.


Requirements:

Must-have demonstrable skills & expertise:

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication, executive presentation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value.
  • Proven hands-on pre-sales and solution-architecture experience in the OSS domain for mobile operators and/or telecommunication vendors, including ownership of RFx responses and customer-facing technical engagements.
  • Deep, demonstrable expertise across the Service Assurance domain – fault, performance, and service-quality management, customer-experience management, and AI/ML-driven assurance (anomaly detection, correlation, automated root-cause analysis, and predictive / proactive assurance).
  • Strong working knowledge of network automation and autonomy – closed-loop assurance and orchestration, intent-based operations, and the TM Forum Autonomous Networks framework (Levels 0–5).
  • Familiarity with O-RAN architecture and SMO / RIC platforms, including the Non-RT RIC (rApps, R1, A1), the Near-RT RIC (xApps, E2), and the O1 / O2 management interfaces.
  • Exposure to public clouds (GCP, Azure, and AWS) and to cloud service models (IaaS, PaaS, DBaaS), with an appreciation of hybrid / multi-cloud and O-Cloud deployment models.
  • Working knowledge of TM Forum standards and Open APIs / Open Digital Architecture (ODA), and of data and observability technologies (streaming pipelines, telemetry, and data lakes).
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and coordinate virtual, cross-functional bid and solution teams across multiple geographies and time zones, and to manage internal and external stakeholders.
  • Willingness to travel as required.

title: Vacation Rental Revenue Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Vacation Rental Revenue Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're hiring a detail-oriented, numbers-driven Vacation Rental Revenue Manager to help Emperor Rentals improve pricing, occupancy, and revenue across our short-term rental portfolio.


This is a fully remote position for candidates currently based in Brazil. You'll work with property performance data, market trends, and pricing tools to help us make smarter revenue decisions every week.


Compensation:

$250 USD per week, paid weekly.


What you'll do:

- Review property performance, pricing, occupancy, ADR, and revenue trends

- Help optimize nightly rates based on seasonality, demand, events, and competitor pricing

- Build and maintain simple revenue reports and forecasts

- Track KPIs and identify opportunities to increase profitability

- Support pricing decisions across Airbnb, short-term rental, and vacation rental channels

- Communicate insights clearly and help the team make data-backed decisions


You may be a great fit if you:

- Are currently based in Brazil and can work remotely

- Are highly analytical, organized, and comfortable working with numbers

- Have strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

- Can spot patterns in data and turn them into practical recommendations

- Are detail-oriented, reliable, and proactive

- Communicate clearly and can work independently

- Are interested in hospitality, Airbnb, short-term rentals, real estate, finance, or revenue management


Nice to have:

- Experience with Airbnb, vacation rentals, hotels, property management, or revenue management

- Experience with pricing tools, market research, dashboards, or financial reporting

- Background in business, finance, economics, analytics, hospitality, or a related field


This role is ideal for someone who enjoys data, pricing strategy, and helping a growing vacation rental company make smarter decisions. If you're based in Brazil and want a remote role where your analysis directly affects business results, we'd love to hear from you.


To apply, please include:

- Your resume

- A short note about your relevant experience

- Your LinkedIn profile, if available

title: Engenheiro de IA Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de IA Sênior em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior para assumir a manutenção e a evolução contínua do Plataforma Agents de IA — nosso framework de orquestração de agentes de IA

que automatiza ciclos completos de desenvolvimento de software (refinement → dev →security → QA → deploy) em nossos projetos reais, em produção.


Esta não é uma vaga de \"treinar modelo\" nem de \"fazer prompt em chatbot\". E engenharia de plataforma com foco em confiabilidade, observabilidade e auto-recuperação de agentes autônomos rodando 24/7 em produção, escrevendo código de desenvolvimento, fazendo git push, abrindo PRs, mergeando em omolog, fazendo cherry-pick para produção.


O que é o Plataforma Agents de IA

Para você decidir se a vaga te interessa, precisa entender o que vai manter:


• Orquestrador: Le as issues (Jira), identifica issues prontas pra cada stage, dispara

agentes (Claude/OpenIA/Gemini/DeepSeek) com contexto rico, valida o resultado, posta

comentario na issue, e avanca o status. Roda em servidores Linux, com auto-update.

• Agentes (@dev, @qa, @sec, @devops, @pm, @po, @sm, @analyst, @architect, @data-engineer, @ux-design-expert): cada um com persona, authority matrix definida, skills executáveis e Gates de qualidade.

• Rules: Mais de 60 regras formais que governam o comportamento dos agentes — desde naming conventions até anti-hallucination validation em 7 camadas. Cada rule nasce de um bug real anonimizado em produção e tem detector regex + caso aplicação por agent.

• Recovery loops: quando um stage falha (CI quebra, conflict de cherry-pick, working tree dirty, autocompact thrashing), o orquestrador detecta deterministicamente e redispara o agente em --mode=ci_recovery com contexto enriquecido. Cap de tentativas, anti-oscilação, escalada pra humano quando esgota.

• Multi-repo via submodules: projetos clientes tem 2 a 30+ sub-repos. Vertex orquestra cherry-pick coordenado, dependency promotion cross-issue, working-tree auto-recovery, validação de paridade de coverage Sonar.

• Stack: Bash 5+ (nucleo), Python, Node.js/TypeScript (CLIs auxiliares), gh CLI, jq,

integrações HTTP com Jira/GitHub via curl + retry policy.


O que você vai fazer


Manutenção do core (40%)

• Manter e evoluir fix de bugs, refatorações controladas, redução de complexidade

ciclomática.

• Garantir que retry policies (Git, PM API, autocompact, recovery loops) continuem

determinísticas e sem custo desnecessário.

• Manter as integrações com Jira API (ADF, webhooks, transitions, comments via helper canônico) funcionais frente a mudancas de schema/comportamento.

• Operar e melhorar o sistema de telemetria (dashboards de custo por agent/stage/issue).

• Diagnosticar incidentes em produção (cliente reporta \"agent crashou em loop\", \"PR criado no repo errado\", \"deploy não promoveu\") e fechar com case study anonimizado + nova rule preventiva.


Evolução de agents e rules (35%)

• Criar e refinar rules quando bugs sistemicos forem detectados — cada rule nova segue o template canônico (detector regex, aplicação por agent, caso real anonimizado, antipatterns, checklist).

• Calibrar prompts dos agents para reduzir alucinação, scope creep, falsos positivos e ciclos de retrabalho.

• Manter o agent-authority.md consistente quando authorities mudarem (ex: @dev

ganhou ownership de PR contra homolog em v2.0.146).

• Criar/refatorar skills.

• Medir impacto de cada rule nova (redução de ciclos de retrabalho, custo USD por issue, leakage rate de bugs Categoria A vs B).


Integrações com LLM CLIs (25%)

• Manter compatibilidade com mudanças de breaking change dos provedores (Claude Code, OpenAI CLI, Gemini CLI, DeepSeek direct).

• Avaliar e integrar novos providers/modelos quando custo-benefício mudar (ex:

DeepSeek-Reasoner para recovery loops, Haiku para classificação).

• Otimizar custo: identificar stages onde modelo menor resolve.

• Implementar fallbacks quando um provider está em outage (ja existe retry transient;

expandir cobertura).

• Trabalhar com tokenização, context windows, autocompact thrashing detection —

entender as falhas reais de cada modelo, não a teoria.


O que esperamos de você


Stack técnica — obrigatório

• Bash/Shell avançado e Linux — você e confortável lendo e escrevendo 500+ linhas de

bash com set -euo pipefail, traps, subshells, file locks, jq, awk, sed, heredocs,

parameter expansion avançada. Não tem medo de poll.sh. Sabe diferenciar ( ) de ((

e porque importa.

• Node.js / TypeScript — escreve TS com strict mode, entende quando não usar Node

(ex: lógica de orquestração crítica fica em bash justamente porque e mais previsível que async JS).

• Git e GitHub avançado — cherry-pick com -m 1, submodules, gh pr

create/merge/edit/list --search, git revert, git rebase --autosquash, resolução

de conflicts nao-triviais, branch protection rules, GitHub Actions workflows.

• Prompt engineering aplicado a agentes autônomos — você já calibrou prompts em produção, sabe que \"diga ao modelo o que não fazer\" raramente funciona, entende o

efeito de exemplos few-shot vs zero-shot, e já debugou ao menos uma vez porque um agente está \"alucinando\" um PR que não criou.


Experiência

• 5+ anos de engenharia de software produzindo sistemas em produção.

• Pelo menos 1 ano com agentes autônomos / orquestração de LLMs em ambiente

real (não bootcamp, não side project) — você sabe a diferença entre \"rodou no demo\" e \"rodou em prod 24/7 sem humano\".

• Histórico comprovado de manter sistemas legados com debt técnico — você não quer \"reescrever do zero\".

• Inglês técnico fluente para leitura/escrita (documentação, issues, comentários de código em inglês obrigatórios; comunicação verbal pode ser PT/EN/ZH dependendo do time).


Mentalidade

• Determinismo > magia. Você prefere uma regex feia em bash que sempre funciona a um ML model elegante que falha em 5% dos casos. Em orquestração de agentes, 5% de falha = produto inviável.

• Forensics sobre intuição. Antes de propor solução, você lê o log, o diff, a issue real do cliente. Não inventa hipótese.

• Documentação executável. Quando você cria uma rule nova, ela tem detector regex que pode rodar em CI. \"Documentei em texto\" não basta.

• Empatia por agente. Você consegue ler um prompt de 8k tokens e identificar onde o modelo vai se confundir, por que, e o que ajustar.


Diferenciais

• Experiencia com Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph ou frameworks de orquestração equivalentes.

• Já implementou ou manteve sistemas de retry policy + backoff exponencial + circuit breaker em integrações com APIs externas instáveis.

• Já trabalhou com monorepos via submodules (nao apenas Nx/Turborepo) e entende

os trade-offs.

• Contribuições open-source em projetos relacionados (CLIs, dev tooling, agent

frameworks).

• Experiencia com DevOps em servidores Linux dedicados (não apenas k8s/cloud managed): systemd, cron, logrotate, monitoring com ferramentas leves.

• Familiaridade com conventional commits, semantic-release, gitflow trifásico

(feature → homolog → main com cherry-pick).

• Já escreveu post-mortem público / case study técnico que outras pessoas referenciam.


Benefícios

• VR/VA – Flash Benefícios

• Assistência Médica – Bradesco Saúde

• Assistência Odontológica – Bradesco

• Programa de Orientação Pessoal – C4Life

• Day Off de Aniversário

• TotalPass

• Parcerias educacionais (FIAP e Alura)

title: Head of Risk (Crypto)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Risk (Crypto) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Head of Risk (Crypto) (Brazil-based)


About the Company:

We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet — and we're looking for exceptional finance professionals to help shape it.


The Role:

We are in search of a business-oriented Head of Risk (Crypto) to lead the overall risk management function for our Brazil entity.


This role focuses on end-to-end risk management across trading, financial crime, and product risk, while ensuring the company operates within its defined risk appetite while actively supporting business growth.


Unlike traditional compliance-heavy roles, this position is about risk ownership: identifying exposures, calibrating tolerance, and driving real-time control execution. We're looking for someone who understands that well-designed risk frameworks are a business enabler, not a brake.


We welcome candidates with a strong crypto or digital asset background. We are equally open to risk leaders from traditional financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, or payments companies who bring deep, transferable expertise and a genuine appetite to operate in a more dynamic, high-growth environment.


What You'll Do:

  • Establish and lead the company's enterprise-wide risk management framework, covering trading and market risk, product risk, financial crime risk, and operational risk.
  • Define, review, and continuously optimise the risk appetite framework in alignment with overall business strategy.
  • Monitor risk activities to ensure alignment with internal risk policies, business objectives, and applicable Brazilian regulatory expectations, and other relevant regulatory authorities.
  • Partner with senior leadership and the Board to embed risk-informed thinking into strategic decision-making.
  • Build and enhance risk control mechanisms across transaction monitoring and risk indicators, market surveillance controls, and product risk assessment frameworks.
  • Identify and stay ahead of emerging risks in trading, product design, and operations, and lead mitigation strategies.
  • Strengthen internal control systems and drive effective risk governance across the organisation.
  • Support the company's ongoing regulatory engagement and risk governance as Brazil's digital asset regulatory framework continues to evolve.


What We're Looking For:

  • 10+ years of risk management experience within crypto, financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, payments, or digital asset businesses.
  • Deep expertise in enterprise risk management, including risk appetite frameworks, governance, and internal controls.
  • Strong understanding of trading, transaction, and financial crime risks, with the ability to balance effective risk management against commercial objectives.
  • Ability to translate risk frameworks into practical controls and work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Operations to implement them.
  • Proven track record operating at or reporting to Executive Committee and Board level.
  • Strategic thinker with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders and embed a strong risk culture across the organisation spanning across operational, market and liquidity risk.
  • Expert understanding of Brazilian regulatory expectations relating to financial institutions and digital asset service providers.
  • Crypto or digital asset experience is strongly preferred, but we also welcome candidates from traditional financial services with strong transferable risk expertise and a genuine interest in the digital asset sector.
  • Functional knowledge of digital asset or digital token listing processes is preferred.

title: Regulatory Compliance Manager (Crypto)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Regulatory Compliance Manager (Crypto) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Remote: Brazil - Remote

Full time


About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role

Our Compliance team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to manage conduct risk.

We’re looking for a Regulatory Compliance Manager to keep our consumer protection practice in compliance. You‘ll advise on crypto compliance requirements and related controls.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.


What you'll be doing

  • Developing and executing a world-class compliance framework, monitoring, and training programme
  • Supporting regulatory licence applications
  • Monitoring, testing, and reporting on the effectiveness of our regulatory architecture
  • Drafting, implementing, and rolling out compliance plans, frameworks, and policies
  • Providing expert regulatory advice to the Operations teams to support product launches
  • Collaborating with international product teams to navigate cross-border compliance requirements
  • Supporting the Head of Compliance in rolling out a robust compliance programme


What you'll need

  • 4+ years of experience advising on compliance-related matters
  • The ability to analyse and interpret data to guide regulatory strategy
  • A solid understanding of the interplay between compliance risk and business risk
  • The ability to communicate positively with regulators and members of various internal teams
  • Excellent analytical skills with a proven track record of learning complex, new regulations quickly
  • Fluency in English


Nice to have

  • Experience working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment



Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

title: Gerente de Projetos
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Gerente de Projetos em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Hr Path Group

O Grupo HR Path, um interveniente global na consultoria de RH, acompanha os seus clientes nos seus projetos de transformação de RH, tanto nos aspectos humanos como nas ferramentas (HRIS). Intervimos na Europa, América e Ásia-Pacífico, para as nossas grandes contas e clientes PME, a fim de lhes oferecer um apoio global no desenvolvimento da sua estratégia de RH.

Aconselhar para executar! HR Path, líder mundial em soluções de RH

  • Advise: Acompanhamos os nossos clientes na transformação da sua função de RH, através de uma redefinição da sua organização de RH e da digitalização do seu HRIS
  • Implement: Como parceiro dos principais editores do mercado, realizamos projetos de implementação técnica e funcional de todas as soluções HRIS (SaaS ou On-Premise)
  • Outsorce: Apoiamos as organizações em todas as etapas de sua jornada de terceirização de RH e folha de pagamento, ajudando-as a operar em conformidade com as normas, de forma eficiente e em grande escala. Nossa mais recente captação de recursos, no valor de 500 milhões de euros, tem como objetivo acelerar nosso crescimento e nossa expansão internacional. Nossa meta é dobrar nossa receita em cinco anos e nos tornarmos líderes mundiais em transformação digital de RH. A HR Path é uma empresa global de consultoria em RH. Oferecemos assessoria profissional e apoio a organizações para as quais o capital humano é essencial em seu processo de transformação de RH. Com presença nas Américas, na Europa e na Ásia-Pacífico, podemos oferecer suporte global no desenvolvimento e na execução da estratégia de RH de nossos clientes.


O que estamos procurando:


  • Espanhol avançado ou fluente;
  • experiência como PM em projetos de implementação;
  • experiência com Workday ou outras soluções HCM;
  • disponibilidade a partir da primeira semana de agosto;


O que oferecemos:

  • Um ambiente de trabalho estimulante no seio de uma cultura empreendedora e internacional
  • Uma abordagem transversal das nossas atividades, que favorece o trabalho em equipe e a excelência
  • Numerosas oportunidades de progressão (mobilidade horizontal, vertical e internacional)
  • Múltiplas oportunidades de formação (universidade interna, certificações)
  • Certificado Happy at Work, oferecemos um bom equilíbrio de vida com possibilidades de teletrabalho
  • Um ambiente de trabalho amigável (atividades de equipe trimestrais, seminário internacional anual)


Nos vemos em breve na HR Path!

title: Professor de Espanhol
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de Espanhol em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Strategy & Operations Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Strategy & Operations Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

At Revolut, Operations means problem-solving at scale. Our team tackles the company’s toughest challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. They design systems that unlock efficiency and power global growth.

We're looking for a Strategy & Operations Manager to help shape how we continue to expand and operate across the globe. You’ll work on high-impact initiatives throughout the business, using insight to solve challenges, scale processes, and deliver better outcomes for our customers.

Watch this video from our team members about what goes into being a Strategy & Operations Manager at Revolut.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

What you’ll be doing

  • Building and optimising scalable processes to continue Revolut's hyper-growth
  • Leading and executing core infrastructure projects
  • Exploring and defining which projects the team should prioritise, and setting a timeline to reach goals quickly
  • Searching for new features to provide a seamless customer experience
  • Managing critical vendor relationships and building performance tracking systems
  • Developing strategic supply chain partnerships and negotiating commercial terms

What you'll need

  • At least a 2:1 degree from a top university
  • 2+ years of work experience in a fast-paced environment
  • A solid track record of taking ownership and leading complex projects end to end
  • A magic skill to break complex problems into smaller ones
  • To enjoy working with data
  • Natural curiosity and a will to make an impact
  • An interest in the financial industry

Nice to have

  • Experience coding with SQL, Python, or R

Compensation range

  • Poland: PLN12,600 - PLN35,800 gross monthly*
  • Lithuania: €2,500 - €8,000 gross monthly*
  • Other locations: Compensation will be discussed during the interview process

*Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and previous experience

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

Você é apaixonado pela língua e cultura italiana e quer ganhar experiência prática? Estamos em busca de um talento para apoiar nosso time de forma dinâmica e totalmente digital!
