title: Creative Strategist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Creative Strategist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are a leading brand in health supplements for women over 40. Our mission is to improve the quality of life for women going through menopause by solving real, everyday challenges—weight gain, hot flashes, insomnia, mood shifts, and more.


We’re looking for a Creative Strategist with strong persuasive advertising and copywriting expertise to own the ideation and messaging that drives performance. You’ll turn customer insights, performance data, and market awareness into high-converting creative angles, scripts, and messaging systems that scale.


Responsibilities

Creative Strategy

  • Contribute to the development of creative strategy for paid social, grounded in direct-response principles
  • Translate performance data, customer research, and competitive insights into effective copy frameworks and angles
  • Support the creation of ad concepts and scalable creative approaches
  • Participate in brainstorming and help shape a testing roadmap of angles, messages, and formats based on clear hypotheses
  • Help maintain creative standards to ensure consistent brand voice and persuasive quality across ads, landing pages, and funnels


Performance & Media Buying Integration

  • Use platform learnings and audience behavior to shape creative testing and copy direction.
  • Build feedback loops so creative evolves weekly based on performance data across ads


AI & Creative Innovation

  • Experience leveraging AI tools to accelerate creative research and performance testing.
  • Proven ability to prepare structured briefs and prompts for AI-generated ad creatives (scripts, hooks, visuals, UGC-style ads).


Qualifications

  • Experience in creative strategy, performance creative, or e-commerce marketing.
  • Hands-on experience with direct-response copywriting
  • Direct experience with women’s wellness, supplements, or health-related products strongly preferred.
  • Proven ability to prepare structured briefs/prompts for AI-generated ad creatives (e.g., scripts, hooks, visuals, UGC-style ads).
  • Strong portfolio of paid social creative with proven ROI.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Working hours

  • 6am - 2pm EST (Monday - Friday)
  • Fully-remote


Compensation

  • $3,500 to $5,000/month


If you think you might be a good fit, please apply.

With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

Employment Type: Freelance / Project-Based

Location: Remote (Work From Home)

title: Data Quality Analyst
description:

JOB DESCRIPTION

Their day to day includes accurately labeling machine learning textual data to refine AI models. This will primarily involve annotating large volumes of textual data according to predefined guidelines. This person must be able to read, write and summarize at a high volume and high accuracy. The Pre-screening tests typing speed (45-60wpm), reading comprehension and pattern recognition. Finding those who are sharp and can navigate ambiguous technical jargon would be a great fit for the role. This will primarily involve annotating large volumes of textual data according to predefined guidelines. Collaborate with team members to identify improvements to the labelling interface or labelling processes in order to drive efficiency and high-quality. Complete assignments by deadlines while meeting team expectations and goals.


REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

Must Haves: Bachelor’s Degree. Open major, provided the academic background demonstrates high-level critical thinking, synthesis, and reading comprehension (e.g., Translation, Law, Psychology, Marketing, or Humanities). C1 (Advanced) or C2 (Mastery) English fluency. 3-4 months of data annotation or LLM evaluation experience (Textual data annotation preferred) Proficiency in reading comprehension and possessive of strong writing skills, with the ability to understand and interpret complex and diverse texts. Ability to work independently, follow instructions, manage time effectively, and meet deadlines in a dynamic and fast-paced environment. Ability to manage ambiguity, uncertainty, and changing priorities with limited resources. Ability to accept and integrate continuous feedback while remaining professional. Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to collaborate within a multi-disciplinary team. Quick learner and self-starter with strong problem-solving skills.


NICE TO HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

Plusses: Experience w RLHF (Reinforcement Learning Human Feedback) Multiple Language proficiency Experience with multi modal data annotation (Text, Image, Video) QA or QC experience

Esta não é uma vaga CLT. É uma parceria.

O mercado está migrando da remuneração por produto para a consultoria fee-based. Cada vez mais consultores querem operar assim, mas esbarram na estrutura que isso exige: research, alocação, back-office, compliance, tecnologia e custódia rodando ao mesmo tempo.


A Nord abre sua rede de parceiros especializados para quem quer crescer sem carregar essa operação sozinho. Você mantém sua marca, sua autonomia e a relação direta com o cliente. A Nord assume a infraestrutura.


A proposta é estender a estrutura que sustenta a nossa própria operação de wealth em benefício do crescimento de operações parceiras.


Você cuida do que ninguém faz no seu lugar: o relacionamento e a proximidade com o cliente.


Para quem faz sentido:

A Day in the Life of a Personalized Internet Ads Assessor:

Join our team today and start putting your skills to work for one of the world's leading online advertising platforms while being a part of a supportive community that offers:

TELUS Digital AI Community

Qualification path

No previous professional experience is required to apply to this role, however, working on this project will require you to pass the basic requirements and go through a standard assessment process. Basic Requirements

Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Strategic Customer Success Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Client

Our client is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (AnPaaS) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology.

With the recent launch of client Intelligence and Intelligence Assistant, we're accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action.


The Role

As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts, building deep relationships to maximize value, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, and fuel retention and expansion.

You'll collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication of complex concepts and proactive guidance.


Why Join Our Customer Success Team

This is a strategic, high-impact role where you'll own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (e.g., NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption).

You'll work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to product growth in embedded AI analytics.


About You

  • You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused.
  • You're a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor to drive customer success.
  • You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs.
  • You're proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities.
  • You're collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning and improvement.


Requirements

  • 3–5+ years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (SaaS/BI/analytics preferred).
  • Strong track record of driving product adoption, value realization, and revenue expansion.
  • Excellent presentation and executive communication skills; experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships.
  • Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio.
  • Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI.
  • Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps.
  • Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required; Portuguese a plus).
  • Results-driven with strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus.
  • Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment while managing multiple priorities.
  • Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/GenAI enablement, or similar technical solutions.


How You'll Ramp

By Day 30

  • Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (client values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes).
  • Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value.

By Day 60

  • Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals).
  • Deepen product and technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work.
  • Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side by side with the team.

By Day 90

  • Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion).
  • Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement.
  • Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals.


Join Client!

Our client is pioneering the future of embedded analytics with AI at the core. This role offers more than a position — it’s an opportunity to shape customer outcomes in a transformative industry, work with a diverse, innovative global team, and grow in a collaborative culture that values impact and inclusivity.

If you're passionate about driving strategic customer success in AI-powered analytics, apply today. Let’s build the next era of intelligent decisions together.

title: Lead Demand & Supply Planning S&OP (SAP)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Demand & Supply Planning S&OP (SAP) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are seeking a highly experienced SAP Plan-to-Deliver (P2D) Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) Consultant to join our team. As a senior consultant, you will be responsible for designing and implementing integrated S&OP solutions in SAP S/4HANA, leading demand and supply planning workshops , and providing business consulting and analysis expertise to drive business transformation .

Key Responsibilities

Solution Design: Design SAP S/4HANA S&OP solutions and define demand planning, supply planning, and inventory optimization processes. Business Analysis: Lead S&OP business workshops, elicit planning requirements, and document As-Is/To-Be processes across demand and supply functions. System Integration: Align planning processes with production, procurement, and sales; ensure integration across supply chain and finance. Implementation & Configuration: Configure SAP IBP/APO/S&OP solutions, set up forecasting models, and enable scenario planning and simulations. Project Leadership: Define scope and timelines for S&OP workstreams and coordinate data integration. Performance Optimization: Improve forecast accuracy, optimize inventory and service levels, and leverage analytics for decision support.

✅ Job Requirements

8+ years of SAP ECC and S/4HANA planning solution experience. Expertise in SAP IBP, APO, and S&OP configuration. Deep knowledge of demand/supply planning, forecasting models, and inventory optimization. Proven manufacturing experience (Required). Automotive industry experience is a strong plus. 1–2 full lifecycle implementations. Advanced/Fluent English language skills are mandatory. Business consulting experience, with a demonstrated track record of acting as a Business Consultant or Business Analyst in SAP transformation programs.

title: Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.


Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers
  • Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)
  • Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)


Market & Network Development

  • Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa)
  • Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape


Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality
  • Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships


Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations
  • Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement


Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners
  • Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets
  • Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics
  • Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM


Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Functional Business Consultant (with Infor WMS experience)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Functional Business Consultant (with Infor WMS experience) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for an experienced Functional Business Consultant (with Infor WMS experience) to support us with WMS Integration and Implementation projects, Audits and Consulting projects.


Innovecs is a global digital transformation tech company with a presence in the US, the UK, the EU, Israel, Australia, and Ukraine. Specializing in software solutions, the Innovecs team has experience in Supply Chain, Healthtech, Software & Hightech, and Gaming.

For the fifth year in a row, Innovecs is included in the Inc. 5000 and recognized in IAOP’s ranking of the best global outsourcing service providers. Innovecs is featured in the Global Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces Ranking and won gold at the Employer Brand Management Awards.


Requirements:

  • 4+ years of experience in functional and business analysis ; preferably supporting and/or configuring Warehouse Management Systems (WMS);
  • Hands-on experience with Infor WMS (must);
  • Experience in Supply Chain , Warehousing, Logistics, or 3PL operations (must);
  • Understanding of warehouse processes including receiving, putaway, replenishment, picking, packing, shipping, and inventory management;
  • Experience onboarding customers and supporting production environments;
  • Experience performing WMS system configuration and minor functional enhancements;
  • Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills;
  • Ability to gather business requirements and translate them into system configuration changes;
  • Experience creating and maintaining functional documentation and training materials;
  • Ability to communicate effectively with warehouse operators, customer stakeholders, and technical teams;
  • Working knowledge of SQL is a plus;
  • Experience with Transportation Management Systems (TMS) is a strong plus;
  • Understanding of 3PL operational processes and customer implementations is a strong plus;
  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and customer-oriented mindset;
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced support environment;
  • Advanced or native English .



Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a primary functional support contact for Infor WMS customers;
  • Support onboarding and implementation of new customers onto the WMS platform;
  • Conduct customer discovery sessions to understand operational requirements and warehouse processes;
  • Configure WMS settings and perform minor system adjustments based on approved business requirements;
  • Troubleshoot functional issues, investigate root causes, and coordinate resolution with technical teams when required;
  • Perform gap analysis between customer requirements and existing WMS functionality;
  • Create and maintain configuration documentation, process flows, user guides, and support materials;
  • Assist with testing activities, including system validation, regression testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT);
  • Deliver end-user and operational training for warehouse personnel and customer teams;
  • Support customer go-live activities and provide post-implementation hypercare support;
  • Monitor support tickets, prioritise customer issues, and ensure timely resolution;
  • Work closely with operations, implementation, and development teams to improve system performance and customer experience;
  • Recommend process improvements and optimisation opportunities within warehouse operations and WMS configuration;
  • Maintain strong understanding of Infor WMS best practices and emerging Supply Chain technology trends;
  • Act as a subject matter expert for Infor WMS configuration and warehouse operational workflows.


  • Nice-to-have: Experience with TMS integrations, EDI processes, 3PL multi-customer warehouse environments, and warehouse automation solutions.

Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud Architect – Google Cloud (GCP) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Buscamos um(a) Cloud Architect – Google Cloud (GCP) com perfil altamente técnico e vocação para ensino e evangelização.

title: VEXOS Platform Manager (Remote)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para VEXOS Platform Manager (Remote) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're Hiring | VEXOS Platform Manager

Remote · Full-Time | Based in Brazil or Mexico


The Render Pros is the presales creative engine behind some of the most ambitious real estate developments in the world. We build photorealistic visualizations, immersive digital experiences, and VEXOS — our proprietary presales platform that transforms how developers market and sell high-value assets before they're built.


We're growing and we need a sharp, reliable operator to help us run VEXOS smoothly.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


About The Render Pros / VEXOS


We are a vertically integrated presales studio. Our clients are real estate developers, luxury asset companies, and investment groups working on projects all around the western hemisphere. VEXOS is our platform product — a fully branded, data-driven presales environment that combines 3D visualization, buyer engagement tools, and lead intelligence. We define the strategy. You help us execute it.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


The Role


The VEXOS Platform Manager supports the delivery and day-to-day management of VEXOS client deployments. You will work closely with our Visualization PMs, development team, and founder to keep projects on track and clients well-supported.


You are organized, communicative, and detail-oriented. You follow process, flag issues early, and represent the platform professionally to clients. You execute the vision — you don't set it.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

title: Voice Over Artist (Brazilian Portuguese)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Voice Over Artist (Brazilian Portuguese) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

TDLR : Pocket FM is hiring remote freelance Brazilian Portuguese Voice Over Artists with professional home studios for long-term, serialized audio fiction. The role requires native fluency and the capacity to deliver 20 to 40 hours of recorded content monthly on a per-hour paid basis.


Voice Over Artist (Brazilian Portuguese)


About Pocket FM


Pocket FM is the world’s leading audio storytelling platform, reaching over 200 million listeners across more than 20 countries. We combine human creativity and innovative technology to create immersive audio series enjoyed by millions of listeners worldwide.


As we expand our Portuguese content library, we are looking for talented, professional Brazilian Voice Over Artists to join our global network of creators.


Role Overview


As a Freelance Voice Over Artist, you will bring complex characters and gripping stories to life in serialized audio fiction. You will collaborate remotely with our production, writing, and quality teams to deliver highly engaging, emotionally authentic performances for long-form series.


This is a remote, contract-based freelance opportunity offering a consistent monthly pipeline of work for a long-term collaboration.


Requirements


  • Native Fluency: Native Brazilian Portuguese speaker with the ability to perform in Neutral Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Versatility & Acting Chops: Strong acting, dubbing, or storytelling skills, with the ability to portray diverse characters across a wide range of ages and emotional profiles.
  • Proven Experience: Background in voice acting, dubbing, audiobook narration, audio drama, or podcasting.
  • Studio Setup: A professional home recording studio environment with a high-quality microphone and reliable, high-speed internet.
  • Capacity: Availability to record and deliver up to 20-40 hours of recorded content per month, while maintaining weekly delivery schedules.
  • Collaboration: Openness to taking performance direction and participating in necessary retakes/feedback sessions.


Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with basic audio editing and file management
  • Experience working remotely with production teams


Engagement Details

  • Contract Type: Freelance / Independent Contractor
  • Location: Remote (Work from your own studio)
  • Compensation: Paid monthly on an hours delivered basis.

How to Apply : Please fill in


What happens after you apply?


Our Casting & Production Process : Here is a look at our step-by-step collaboration pipeline:

1.Internal Evaluation:

Our production team will carefully review your voice demos, studio specs, and portfolio to see if your vocal profile matches our upcoming projects.

2.Show Casting & Voice Testing:

If your profile fits, we will invite you to a voice test for the specific audio series we are casting. This helps us ensure your performance aligns perfectly with the character's vision.

3.Contract & Legal Alignment:

Once selected for a show, we will finalize a freelance legal agreement. This contract will clearly outline the voice usage rights for the series and formalize our agreed monthly payment terms.

4.Calibration & Onboarding:

Before the official recording begins, we will run a brief calibration session. This ensures your studio's audio mastering levels match our technical delivery standards for a seamless workflow.

5.Production & Monthly Deliveries:

Recording begins! Our long-form audio series typically span 150 to 300 hours in total. We partner with you for the long haul, expecting a steady delivery of 20 to 40 hours of recorded content per month until the series is complete.

title: Senior DBA + C#/.NET Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior DBA + C#/.NET Developer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This position requires fluent English - do not apply with a non-English profile/resume as it will be automatically filtered.


Position Overview  


We are seeking a Senior Database Administrator with C#/.NET development experience  to join our growing engineering team. This role is intentionally hybrid: you will interact with/improve code related to our software database queries, while also owning the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost management of our SQL databases . 


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is database-centric but not database-only —someone who enjoys writing production code, building features that interact heavily with data, and taking responsibility for how the database performs in real-world, high-availability environments. 


You will work across application code, database architecture, and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to deliver scalable, reliable systems. 


Key Responsibilities  


Database Architecture, Performance & Ownership  

  • Design, evolve, and optimize database schemas, indexes, queries, and stored procedures  to support high-performance application workloads 
  • Own database performance tuning , query optimization, and capacity planning across environments 
  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability  strategies in Azure SQL 
  • Monitor and proactively address performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, blocking, and resource contention  
  • Own database cost management  in Azure, including sizing, scaling strategies, and cost optimization 
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and operational excellence  throughout the application lifecycle 


Software Development & Feature Delivery  

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services  using C# and .NET 
  • Build application features that interact deeply with the database , balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability 
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs  and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems 
  • Participate in architectural discussions  and influence technical direction across the stack 
  • Perform code reviews  and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers 


Azure Cloud & DevOps  

  • Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure , with a focus on reliability and observability 
  • Support CI/CD pipelines  and deployment practices using Azure DevOps 
  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution 
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost 


Required Qualifications  


Experience & Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience 
  • 7+ years  of professional experience in C#/.NET software development 
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency) 


Technical Skills (Priority Order)  

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise , including: 

Advanced T-SQL 

Stored procedures and query optimization 

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis 

Performance tuning and troubleshooting 

  • Proven experience owning database operations , including: 

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery 

Performance monitoring and scaling 

  • Cost and capacity management in Azure 
  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework  
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs  
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services , including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)  
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum  development methodologies 
  • Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps  

Soft Skills  

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems 
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability 
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams 

Bonus Points  

  • Microsoft Azure certifications (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect, or similar) 
  • Experience with Plivo or Twilio  
  • Experience with message-based systems  (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.) 
  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices  and production operations 
  • Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments  
  • Prior team lead experience

What We Offer  

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience 
  • Opportunity to own critical systems  and influence architectural decisions 
  • A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

As a Sr. Talent Acquisition Partner at Sealed Air, you will collaborate closely with HR Partners and Business Leaders to identify critical hiring needs and build a strong pipeline of passive candidates. title: Head of Risk (Crypto)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Risk (Crypto) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Head of Risk (Crypto) (Brazil-based)


About the Company:

We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet — and we're looking for exceptional finance professionals to help shape it.


The Role:

We are in search of a business-oriented Head of Risk (Crypto) to lead the overall risk management function for our Brazil entity.


This role focuses on end-to-end risk management across trading, financial crime, and product risk, while ensuring the company operates within its defined risk appetite while actively supporting business growth.


Unlike traditional compliance-heavy roles, this position is about risk ownership: identifying exposures, calibrating tolerance, and driving real-time control execution. We're looking for someone who understands that well-designed risk frameworks are a business enabler, not a brake.


We welcome candidates with a strong crypto or digital asset background. We are equally open to risk leaders from traditional financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, or payments companies who bring deep, transferable expertise and a genuine appetite to operate in a more dynamic, high-growth environment.


What You'll Do:

  • Establish and lead the company's enterprise-wide risk management framework, covering trading and market risk, product risk, financial crime risk, and operational risk.
  • Define, review, and continuously optimise the risk appetite framework in alignment with overall business strategy.
  • Monitor risk activities to ensure alignment with internal risk policies, business objectives, and applicable Brazilian regulatory expectations, and other relevant regulatory authorities.
  • Partner with senior leadership and the Board to embed risk-informed thinking into strategic decision-making.
  • Build and enhance risk control mechanisms across transaction monitoring and risk indicators, market surveillance controls, and product risk assessment frameworks.
  • Identify and stay ahead of emerging risks in trading, product design, and operations, and lead mitigation strategies.
  • Strengthen internal control systems and drive effective risk governance across the organisation.
  • Support the company's ongoing regulatory engagement and risk governance as Brazil's digital asset regulatory framework continues to evolve.


What We're Looking For:

  • 10+ years of risk management experience within crypto, financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, payments, or digital asset businesses.
  • Deep expertise in enterprise risk management, including risk appetite frameworks, governance, and internal controls.
  • Strong understanding of trading, transaction, and financial crime risks, with the ability to balance effective risk management against commercial objectives.
  • Ability to translate risk frameworks into practical controls and work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Operations to implement them.
  • Proven track record operating at or reporting to Executive Committee and Board level.
  • Strategic thinker with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders and embed a strong risk culture across the organisation spanning across operational, market and liquidity risk.
  • Expert understanding of Brazilian regulatory expectations relating to financial institutions and digital asset service providers.
  • Crypto or digital asset experience is strongly preferred, but we also welcome candidates from traditional financial services with strong transferable risk expertise and a genuine interest in the digital asset sector.
  • Functional knowledge of digital asset or digital token listing processes is preferred.

title: Staffing Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Staffing Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who We Are


MAVI is on a mission to globalize the finance and accounting function by connecting the best talent in the world with high-performing US companies. We’re building the world’s largest network of top-tier finance talent, using an AI-powered platform for sourcing, vetting & matching, and disrupting a legacy $100Bn+ industry.



What the Platform Team Does at MAVI


Platform Management drives the strategic side of our recruiting ecosystem, interpreting client needs, aligning talent, and ensuring successful placements. The Platform team is responsible for running the core operations of MAVI’s talent marketplace. They manage the full journey, from understanding customer needs to matching talent, placing them in roles, and ensuring both sides have a great experience. Their work ensures the marketplace runs smoothly, efficiently, and with high-quality service.


About the Role


We’re hiring a Platform Specia list who can help drive the lifeblood of our talent marketplace - the end-to-end process from talent matching, talent placement & account management. This person will work directly with the current Platform Manager at MAVI and work as a tag team to close deals, manage ongoing engagements, resolve ad-hoc issues that arise, improve processes & work with the engineering team to inject automation into various workflows.



What You'll Do


  • Work with Leadership and the Platform Manager to understand job needs, ideal candidate profiles, and help match the right talent to open roles.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for MAVI customers , build trust, manage ongoing engagements, and keep them regularly updated.
  • Build strong, long-term relationships with customers by understanding their goals, preferences, and business needs.
  • Support the end-to-end matching process by reviewing candidate documentation and identifying best-fit talent for open positions.
  • Write compelling, clear, and engaging job descriptions to attract talent from our internal network and match them with active opportunities.
  • Assist in creating professional and polished candidate profiles for presentation to customers.
  • Provide support throughout the hiring process, ensuring consistent communication between talent and customers to keep things moving.
  • Resolve issues that arise during active engagements, ensuring alignment, satisfaction, and long-term success for both parties.
  • Collaborate with leadership and other internal teams to refine and enhance our account and engagement management processes.


What We’re Looking For


  • At least 4-9 years of experience in account management, staffing, recruitment coordination, or a related role.
  • Very strong English communication skills, both written and verbal, is a must.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, and customer relationships in a dynamic environment.
  • Proven ability to work in high-speed environments, to operate with high urgency, and be extremely customer-centric.
  • High level of discretion and judgment when handling confidential or sensitive information.
  • Experience working with global clients or in remote-first environments.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and adapt quickly to change.
  • Exceptional communication, organizational, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and strategic approach.
  • Someone who is humble, hungry and best in class at what they do.


Why You Should Join


  • Impact: You’re not just another cog in the machine; you’ll help build the talent acquisition motion ground up that powers the entire business.
  • No Bureaucracy: Work directly with founders, move fast, and own meaningful projects. We’re playing to win here. This is a startup and we’re looking for new ideas, bold moves, and scrappiness.
  • Competitive Pay: We believe in sharing the upside with those who build it :)
  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere, but expect high velocity and deep collaboration.


Equal Opportunity Statement


At MAVI, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applicants of every background, identity, and life experience. Employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet.


Why this role

We are entering the Brazilian market as a Banco Central do Brasil-authorised Virtual Asset Service Provider, and you would be our first Head of Compliance on the ground. The authorisation itself depends on having someone the BCB trusts in this seat — someone who treats AML/CFT, KYC, and disclosure as the actual job, not paperwork around it. In your first year, you will have stood up the compliance program the regulator expects to see and built the company's track record with the BCB from zero.


What you'll do

  • Hold statutory officer responsibility for compliance at a BCB-authorised VASP, with personal accountability for acting in good faith and in the company's best interest
  • Own the design and effectiveness of the AML/CFT and KYC program, including transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, and suspicious activity reporting
  • Act as the primary point of contact with the BCB and COAF for compliance matters, including audits, inspections, and ad hoc information requests
  • Maintain personal fitness and propriety; disclose, without prompting, anything that touches your fitness, propriety, or potential conflicts — to the company and to the BCB
  • Drive the VASP authorisation process forward on the compliance workstream, including declarations and documentation the BCB requests on its own timeline


What you'll bring

Must-have

  • Brazilian permanent residency or citizenship, with the ability to maintain ordinary residency in Brazil for as long as the role requires
  • You hold no competing officer or director seat at another regulated entity in Brazil
  • Direct compliance experience at a BCB-regulated institution (bank, securities broker/distributor, foreign exchange dealer) or at a crypto exchange/VASP
  • Hands-on ownership of AML/CFT and KYC programs, not just oversight of someone else's
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, written and spoken

title: Product Analyst – Vmake · Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Product Analyst – Vmake · Brazil em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Why We Need You

We’re building an AI-powered video creation platform that empowers creators, brands, and e-commerce sellers to produce high-performing content with ease. As our Product Analyst, you’ll combine product thinking, user research, and data-driven insights to help shape features that resonate with Brazilian creators.


You’ll work closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, and the creator community to identify opportunities, validate ideas, and ensure our product solves real user problems. Your understanding of short-form video trends, creator workflows, and AI-powered content creation will directly influence our product roadmap.


What You’ll Do

  • Become a power user of Vmake’s AI video tools by testing new features, identifying usability issues, and evaluating the overall creator experience.
  • Analyze user behavior, creator feedback, and product metrics to uncover opportunities for product improvements.
  • Monitor trends across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, TikTok Shop, Amazon, Shopify, and emerging creator platforms, translating market insights into actionable product recommendations.
  • Partner with Product Managers to define product requirements, prioritize enhancements, and support roadmap planning.
  • Conduct competitive research on AI-powered creative tools and video editing platforms, identifying best practices and product gaps.
  • Gather, organize, and synthesize qualitative and quantitative user feedback into clear product recommendations.
  • Collaborate closely with Design and Engineering teams throughout feature discovery, testing, and iteration.
  • Assist in defining success metrics and evaluating feature performance after launch.
  • Create documentation including product briefs, user stories, competitive analyses, and feature specifications.


Who You Are

  • 3–5 years of experience in Product, Product Analysis, Product Operations, or a related product role within SaaS, AI, creator economy, social media, or e-commerce technology.
  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian creator ecosystem and short-form video platforms.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered creative tools and enthusiasm for generative AI technologies.
  • Experience translating customer pain points into clear product requirements.
  • Strong analytical thinking with the ability to interpret both qualitative and quantitative data.
  • Excellent communication skills and experience working cross-functionally with Product, Design, and Engineering.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with changing priorities.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Active content creator with a public portfolio or social media presence.
  • Experience with TikTok Shop, Amazon, Shopify, or creator-focused commerce platforms.
  • Experience conducting user interviews, usability testing, or product discovery.
  • Familiarity with wireframing tools such as Figma.
  • Experience using analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA4, or similar platforms.

title: Power Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Power Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Transmission Line Engineer - LATAM


Our client is seeking a Transmission Line Engineer to join their growing engineering team. This role will be responsible for supporting the analysis, design, and execution of overhead transmission line projects for utility and energy clients.


The ideal candidate will have experience in transmission line design, power systems, and engineering project delivery, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.


This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated engineer who enjoys solving technical challenges, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and contributing to the successful delivery of critical power infrastructure projects.


Key Responsibilities

  • Perform and coordinate transmission line engineering activities for new and existing overhead transmission projects.
  • Complete engineering analysis, calculations, and design work associated with transmission line systems.
  • Provide technical support to internal stakeholders, customers, and project teams.
  • Review project requirements and specifications and recommend design improvements when necessary.
  • Solve complex engineering challenges related to transmission line design and construction.
  • Prepare technical reports, analyses, calculations, and presentations.
  • Perform and oversee transmission line calculations, including:
  • Sag-tension analysis
  • Wire blowout calculations
  • Swing angle analysis
  • Damper recommendations

title: Presales Solution Architect, OSS
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Presales Solution Architect, OSS em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Responsibilities:

  • Act as the lead OSS solution architect across the full pre-sales lifecycle – from opportunity qualification and technical discovery through proof-of-concept, proposal, and contract award – partnering closely with Sales leadership to shape, qualify, and grow the regional pipeline.
  • Own and orchestrate end-to-end responses to RFx (RFI / RFP / RFQ), including solution design, compliance and traceability matrices, win themes, technical narratives, effort and Bill-of-Materials estimation, assumptions, and risk identification – driving on-time, high-quality, fully compliant submissions.
  • Design and articulate end-to-end OSS solution architectures spanning Service Assurance, Service Orchestration & Fulfilment, Inventory, and closed-loop automation, mapping the Rakuten Symphony portfolio to operator pain points and measurable business outcomes.
  • Position and demonstrate the Service Assurance portfolio – fault, performance, and service-quality management; AI/ML-driven anomaly detection, alarm correlation and noise reduction; automated root-cause analysis; and predictive, proactive assurance – including customer-experience and network-slice assurance for 5G Standalone.
  • Develop solutions, value cases, and demonstrations around SMO (Service Management & Orchestration) and RIC (RAN Intelligent Controller) platforms, including the Non-RT RIC and rApps (R1, A1 interfaces) and the Near-RT RIC and xApps (E2 interface), addressing use cases such as RAN energy savings, traffic steering, QoE optimization, massive-MIMO and interference management, and anomaly detection.
  • Champion network automation and autonomy – closed-loop operations, intent-based and intent-driven management, and the journey toward TM Forum Level 4 autonomous networks – and translate these capabilities into concrete, quantifiable value propositions for customers.
  • Lead technical proofs-of-concept, lab trials, product demonstrations, and solution integration and validation, tailoring demo environments to each customer’s specific use cases, KPIs, and success criteria.
  • Be responsible and accountable for authoring technical solution documents, high-level designs, design proposals, sizing and Bill-of-Materials, and TCO / ROI models that withstand customer and third-party technical scrutiny.
  • Serve as the trusted technical advisor to customers and prospects – running discovery workshops, executive briefings, and technical deep-dives – and manage technical stakeholder relationships from engineering and operations teams up to C-level.
  • Work cross-functionally with internal teams – Product Management, Engineering, Delivery / Professional Services, Commercial, and Bid Management – and with external parties – operators, system integrators, hyperscalers, and O-RAN / ecosystem partners – to assemble winning and deliverable solutions.
  • Generate thought-leadership content – white papers, blogs, reference architectures, and webinars – and represent Rakuten Symphony at industry events and standards / community forums such as TM Forum and the O-RAN ALLIANCE.
  • Stay ahead of telecom market trends – Open RAN, 5G and 5G-Advanced, cloud-native CNFs and Kubernetes, observability and telemetry, GenAI and agentic AI for operations, and the shift toward data-driven, autonomous networks – and bring that insight into customer conversations and internal strategy.


Requirements:

Must-have demonstrable skills & expertise:

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication, executive presentation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value.
  • Proven hands-on pre-sales and solution-architecture experience in the OSS domain for mobile operators and/or telecommunication vendors, including ownership of RFx responses and customer-facing technical engagements.
  • Deep, demonstrable expertise across the Service Assurance domain – fault, performance, and service-quality management, customer-experience management, and AI/ML-driven assurance (anomaly detection, correlation, automated root-cause analysis, and predictive / proactive assurance).
  • Strong working knowledge of network automation and autonomy – closed-loop assurance and orchestration, intent-based operations, and the TM Forum Autonomous Networks framework (Levels 0–5).
  • Familiarity with O-RAN architecture and SMO / RIC platforms, including the Non-RT RIC (rApps, R1, A1), the Near-RT RIC (xApps, E2), and the O1 / O2 management interfaces.
  • Exposure to public clouds (GCP, Azure, and AWS) and to cloud service models (IaaS, PaaS, DBaaS), with an appreciation of hybrid / multi-cloud and O-Cloud deployment models.
  • Working knowledge of TM Forum standards and Open APIs / Open Digital Architecture (ODA), and of data and observability technologies (streaming pipelines, telemetry, and data lakes).
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and coordinate virtual, cross-functional bid and solution teams across multiple geographies and time zones, and to manage internal and external stakeholders.
  • Willingness to travel as required.

title: Social Media Lead/Community Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Social Media Lead/Community Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We’re hiring: Social Lead / Social Media & Community Manager

Earned Media Productions (EMP) is looking for someone who can turn podcasts into growth engines — and build engaged communities around them.

This role sits at the intersection of content distribution, social strategy, and audience engagement.


What you’ll do:

• Own daily posting across TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, and more

• Turn podcast episodes into high-performing short-form content

• Decide what clips get posted, when, and where

• Manage comments, DMs, and community engagement across platforms

• Help shape the voice and presence of brands online

• Analyze performance and double down on what works


Key Responsibilities 1. Content Distribution & Posting
  • Own daily posting across all social platforms (TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, etc.)
  • Manage scheduling, captions, hashtags, and formatting per platform
  • Ensure consistent, high-volume output of podcast clips
2. Podcast Clip Strategy
  • Turn long-form podcast episodes into a structured content distribution plan
  • Decide what clips get posted, when, and where
  • Collaborate with editors to guide clip selection and packaging (hooks, titles, formats)
3. Growth & Optimization
  • Analyze performance data to identify winning formats, topics, and hooks
  • Continuously iterate on posting strategy to increase:
  • Views
  • Engagement
  • Follower growth
  • A/B test captions, formats, and posting times
4. Platform Expertise
  • Stay on top of trends, algorithm changes, and best practices across platforms
  • Adapt content strategy accordingly (e.g., TikTok vs. Reels vs. Shorts nuances)
5. Systems & Organization
  • Build and manage a content calendar + distribution system
  • Track posted content and performance metrics
  • Ensure no content bottlenecks between editing → posting → reporting
6. Collaboration
  • Work closely with:
  • Editors (to refine clips)
  • Creators/clients (to align on voice and goals)
  • Leadership (to align on growth strategy)


What we’re looking for:

• Experience growing social accounts (especially short-form video)

• Strong understanding of TikTok / Reels / Shorts

• Someone who actually gets internet culture + audience behavior

• Ability to manage both content output + community interaction

Must-Haves
  • 2–4+ years managing social media accounts (preferably podcast or creator-led content)
  • Proven experience growing accounts through short-form video
  • Deep understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts
  • Strong instincts for what makes content go viral
  • Experience managing high-volume posting (multiple posts/day)
  • Fluent in English - Speaking and Writing. 
Nice-to-Haves
  • Experience working with podcasts or long-form content
  • Background in content editing or scripting
  • Familiarity with tools like:
  • Asana/ Slack
  • Social schedulers (Later, Hootsuite, etc.)
  • Analytics tools
  • Experience managing multiple brands or clients
Bonus:

• Experience with podcasts or creator-led brands

• Background in content editing or scripting

• Experience building or managing online communities

This is a high-impact role with real ownership across content, distribution, and community.

description:

Quem somos:

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.


O que buscamos:

Estamos em busca de um Designer gráfico para o time de impressão, que seja capaz de trabalhar com rapidez, eficiência e mantendo grande atenção aos detalhes. O profissional deve ser altamente organizado e conseguir trabalhar em mais de um projeto ao mesmo tempo. Entre as atividades, a principal será fazer ajustes e alterações de cor, formato, texto, imagens e preparação dos arquivos para impressão (com sangria, marcas de corte e ficha técnica).

O candidato precisa ter um conhecimento avançado no Adobe InDesign já que 95% do trabalho será feito nele, e o nível de inglês para escrita e interpretação de texto também precisa ser avançado. A atividade diária principal será receber artes prontas das agências dos EUA para executar ajustes (no InDesign) conforme comentários (em inglês) feitos no PDF. Além disso, será necessário também montar facas especiais e fazer o envio dos arquivos para a gráfica.

Num primeiro momento o profissional estará sob supervisão para garantir o entendimento e fluxo de funcionamento do estúdio, mas com o passar do tempo a idéia é ganhar autonomia para realizar as tarefas mais cotidianas e recorrentes sem muita supervisão.


Pré-Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada no segmento impresso e em todos os detalhes que o meio exige (marcas de corte, sangría, margens de segurança, dobras, vinco, cores CMYK, facas especiais, e fichas técnicas);
  • Graduação em Design Gráfico, Desenho Industrial ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência de pelo menos 5+ anos na função como designer gráfico no ramo impresso.

title: Member of the Board of Advisors
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Member of the Board of Advisors em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company


Founded in 1950, Westfield FC has been an important part of its local football community for more than 75 years. Today, the club competes in the 8th tier of English football and is backed by an ambitious group of investors committed to building a sustainable, community-driven club with long-term growth potential. Our vision is to earn promotion through the English football pyramid and ultimately reach the English Football League through strategic investment, strong leadership, and community engagement. Westfield FC also competes in FA Cup and FA Trophy qualifying matches each season, providing exciting opportunities to showcase the club on a national stage while pursuing success both on and off the pitch.


Company Website:


About the Role: Member of the Board of Advisors


Westfield FC is seeking accomplished professionals, entrepreneurs, sports executives, investors, and football enthusiasts to join our Board of Advisors. Advisors will help promote the club, expand our network, identify strategic opportunities, and support the long-term growth of Westfield FC. This is an opportunity to become part of an ambitious ownership group working to build a successful football club for generations to come.


We are also actively seeking advisors from Brazil to help represent and support Westfield FC within their local market and networks.


Key Responsibilities


  • Promote Westfield FC within your professional and personal network.
  • Introduce potential sponsors, commercial partners, investors, and strategic relationships.
  • Provide strategic guidance on club growth, marketing, fundraising, commercial partnerships, and community engagement.
  • Support revenue-generating and brand-building initiatives when appropriate.
  • Participate in periodic advisory meetings and provide feedback on key priorities.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Passion for football and the business of sports.
  • Experience as an executive, entrepreneur, investor, advisor, or business leader.
  • Strong professional network that can support club growth.
  • Interest in sports investing, football operations, sponsorships, or community development.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.


Compensation & Benefits


This advisory role offers sweat equity aligned with advisor contributions and the long-term success of Westfield FC. Advisors will have the opportunity to help shape the strategic direction of the club, work alongside the ownership group, expand their network within the football industry, and participate in an exciting football investment journey.


Why Join Us


Join an ambitious ownership group building a historic football club with a bold long-term vision. Inspired by stories like Welcome to Wrexham, our goal is to build a sustainable, community-focused club capable of climbing the English football pyramid and ultimately reaching the English Football League. If you’ve ever wanted to help shape the future of a football club from the inside while sharing in its long-term success, this is a unique opportunity.


Equal Opportunity Statement


Westfield FC is an equal opportunity organization. We are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and respectful environment and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.


Selection decisions are based on qualifications, merit, business needs, and the ability to contribute to the responsibilities of the advisory role.

title: Engenheiro de IA Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de IA Sênior em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior para assumir a manutenção e a evolução contínua do Plataforma Agents de IA — nosso framework de orquestração de agentes de IA

que automatiza ciclos completos de desenvolvimento de software (refinement → dev →security → QA → deploy) em nossos projetos reais, em produção.


Esta não é uma vaga de \"treinar modelo\" nem de \"fazer prompt em chatbot\". E engenharia de plataforma com foco em confiabilidade, observabilidade e auto-recuperação de agentes autônomos rodando 24/7 em produção, escrevendo código de desenvolvimento, fazendo git push, abrindo PRs, mergeando em omolog, fazendo cherry-pick para produção.


O que é o Plataforma Agents de IA

Para você decidir se a vaga te interessa, precisa entender o que vai manter:


• Orquestrador: Le as issues (Jira), identifica issues prontas pra cada stage, dispara

agentes (Claude/OpenIA/Gemini/DeepSeek) com contexto rico, valida o resultado, posta

comentario na issue, e avanca o status. Roda em servidores Linux, com auto-update.

• Agentes (@dev, @qa, @sec, @devops, @pm, @po, @sm, @analyst, @architect, @data-engineer, @ux-design-expert): cada um com persona, authority matrix definida, skills executáveis e Gates de qualidade.

• Rules: Mais de 60 regras formais que governam o comportamento dos agentes — desde naming conventions até anti-hallucination validation em 7 camadas. Cada rule nasce de um bug real anonimizado em produção e tem detector regex + caso aplicação por agent.

• Recovery loops: quando um stage falha (CI quebra, conflict de cherry-pick, working tree dirty, autocompact thrashing), o orquestrador detecta deterministicamente e redispara o agente em --mode=ci_recovery com contexto enriquecido. Cap de tentativas, anti-oscilação, escalada pra humano quando esgota.

• Multi-repo via submodules: projetos clientes tem 2 a 30+ sub-repos. Vertex orquestra cherry-pick coordenado, dependency promotion cross-issue, working-tree auto-recovery, validação de paridade de coverage Sonar.

• Stack: Bash 5+ (nucleo), Python, Node.js/TypeScript (CLIs auxiliares), gh CLI, jq,

integrações HTTP com Jira/GitHub via curl + retry policy.


O que você vai fazer


Manutenção do core (40%)

• Manter e evoluir fix de bugs, refatorações controladas, redução de complexidade

ciclomática.

• Garantir que retry policies (Git, PM API, autocompact, recovery loops) continuem

determinísticas e sem custo desnecessário.

• Manter as integrações com Jira API (ADF, webhooks, transitions, comments via helper canônico) funcionais frente a mudancas de schema/comportamento.

• Operar e melhorar o sistema de telemetria (dashboards de custo por agent/stage/issue).

• Diagnosticar incidentes em produção (cliente reporta \"agent crashou em loop\", \"PR criado no repo errado\", \"deploy não promoveu\") e fechar com case study anonimizado + nova rule preventiva.


Evolução de agents e rules (35%)

• Criar e refinar rules quando bugs sistemicos forem detectados — cada rule nova segue o template canônico (detector regex, aplicação por agent, caso real anonimizado, antipatterns, checklist).

• Calibrar prompts dos agents para reduzir alucinação, scope creep, falsos positivos e ciclos de retrabalho.

• Manter o agent-authority.md consistente quando authorities mudarem (ex: @dev

ganhou ownership de PR contra homolog em v2.0.146).

• Criar/refatorar skills.

• Medir impacto de cada rule nova (redução de ciclos de retrabalho, custo USD por issue, leakage rate de bugs Categoria A vs B).


Integrações com LLM CLIs (25%)

• Manter compatibilidade com mudanças de breaking change dos provedores (Claude Code, OpenAI CLI, Gemini CLI, DeepSeek direct).

• Avaliar e integrar novos providers/modelos quando custo-benefício mudar (ex:

DeepSeek-Reasoner para recovery loops, Haiku para classificação).

• Otimizar custo: identificar stages onde modelo menor resolve.

• Implementar fallbacks quando um provider está em outage (ja existe retry transient;

expandir cobertura).

• Trabalhar com tokenização, context windows, autocompact thrashing detection —

entender as falhas reais de cada modelo, não a teoria.


O que esperamos de você


Stack técnica — obrigatório

• Bash/Shell avançado e Linux — você e confortável lendo e escrevendo 500+ linhas de

bash com set -euo pipefail, traps, subshells, file locks, jq, awk, sed, heredocs,

parameter expansion avançada. Não tem medo de poll.sh. Sabe diferenciar ( ) de ((

e porque importa.

• Node.js / TypeScript — escreve TS com strict mode, entende quando não usar Node

(ex: lógica de orquestração crítica fica em bash justamente porque e mais previsível que async JS).

• Git e GitHub avançado — cherry-pick com -m 1, submodules, gh pr

create/merge/edit/list --search, git revert, git rebase --autosquash, resolução

de conflicts nao-triviais, branch protection rules, GitHub Actions workflows.

• Prompt engineering aplicado a agentes autônomos — você já calibrou prompts em produção, sabe que \"diga ao modelo o que não fazer\" raramente funciona, entende o

efeito de exemplos few-shot vs zero-shot, e já debugou ao menos uma vez porque um agente está \"alucinando\" um PR que não criou.


Experiência

• 5+ anos de engenharia de software produzindo sistemas em produção.

• Pelo menos 1 ano com agentes autônomos / orquestração de LLMs em ambiente

real (não bootcamp, não side project) — você sabe a diferença entre \"rodou no demo\" e \"rodou em prod 24/7 sem humano\".

• Histórico comprovado de manter sistemas legados com debt técnico — você não quer \"reescrever do zero\".

• Inglês técnico fluente para leitura/escrita (documentação, issues, comentários de código em inglês obrigatórios; comunicação verbal pode ser PT/EN/ZH dependendo do time).


Mentalidade

• Determinismo > magia. Você prefere uma regex feia em bash que sempre funciona a um ML model elegante que falha em 5% dos casos. Em orquestração de agentes, 5% de falha = produto inviável.

• Forensics sobre intuição. Antes de propor solução, você lê o log, o diff, a issue real do cliente. Não inventa hipótese.

• Documentação executável. Quando você cria uma rule nova, ela tem detector regex que pode rodar em CI. \"Documentei em texto\" não basta.

• Empatia por agente. Você consegue ler um prompt de 8k tokens e identificar onde o modelo vai se confundir, por que, e o que ajustar.


Diferenciais

• Experiencia com Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph ou frameworks de orquestração equivalentes.

• Já implementou ou manteve sistemas de retry policy + backoff exponencial + circuit breaker em integrações com APIs externas instáveis.

• Já trabalhou com monorepos via submodules (nao apenas Nx/Turborepo) e entende

os trade-offs.

• Contribuições open-source em projetos relacionados (CLIs, dev tooling, agent

frameworks).

• Experiencia com DevOps em servidores Linux dedicados (não apenas k8s/cloud managed): systemd, cron, logrotate, monitoring com ferramentas leves.

• Familiaridade com conventional commits, semantic-release, gitflow trifásico

(feature → homolog → main com cherry-pick).

• Já escreveu post-mortem público / case study técnico que outras pessoas referenciam.


Benefícios

• VR/VA – Flash Benefícios

• Assistência Médica – Bradesco Saúde

• Assistência Odontológica – Bradesco

• Programa de Orientação Pessoal – C4Life

• Day Off de Aniversário

• TotalPass

• Parcerias educacionais (FIAP e Alura)

Voice Over Artist (Brazilian Portuguese)


About Pocket FM


Pocket FM is the world’s leading audio storytelling platform, reaching over 200 million listeners across more than 20 countries. We combine human creativity and innovative technology to create immersive audio series enjoyed by millions of listeners worldwide.


As we expand our Portuguese content library, we are looking for talented, professional Brazilian Voice Over Artists to join our global network of creators.

This is a remote, contract-based freelance opportunity offering a consistent monthly pipeline of work for a long-term collaboration.


Requirements


  • Native Fluency: Native Brazilian Portuguese speaker with the ability to perform in Neutral Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Versatility & Acting Chops: Strong acting, dubbing, or storytelling skills, with the ability to portray diverse characters across a wide range of ages and emotional profiles.
  • Proven Experience: Background in voice acting, dubbing, audiobook narration, audio drama, or podcasting.
  • Studio Setup: A professional home recording studio environment with a high-quality microphone and reliable, high-speed internet.
  • Capacity: Availability to record and deliver up to 20-40 hours of recorded content per month, while maintaining weekly delivery schedules.
  • Collaboration: Openness to taking performance direction and participating in necessary retakes/feedback sessions.


Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with basic audio editing and file management
  • Experience working remotely with production teams


Engagement Details

  • Contract Type: Freelance / Independent Contractor
  • Location: Remote (Work from your own studio)
  • Compensation: Paid monthly on an hours delivered basis.

How to Apply : Please fill in


What happens after you apply?


Our Casting & Production Process : Here is a look at our step-by-step collaboration pipeline:

1.Internal Evaluation:

Our production team will carefully review your voice demos, studio specs, and portfolio to see if your vocal profile matches our upcoming projects.

2.Show Casting & Voice Testing:

If your profile fits, we will invite you to a voice test for the specific audio series we are casting. This helps us ensure your performance aligns perfectly with the character's vision.

3.Contract & Legal Alignment:

Once selected for a show, we will finalize a freelance legal agreement. This contract will clearly outline the voice usage rights for the series and formalize our agreed monthly payment terms.

4.Calibration & Onboarding:

Before the official recording begins, we will run a brief calibration session. This ensures your studio's audio mastering levels match our technical delivery standards for a seamless workflow.

5.Production & Monthly Deliveries:

Recording begins! Our long-form audio series typically span 150 to 300 hours in total. We partner with you for the long haul, expecting a steady delivery of 20 to 40 hours of recorded content per month until the series is complete.

title: Senior GCP QA Auditor - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior GCP QA Auditor - Brazil em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior GCP QA Auditor – Full Time – Permanent – Remote – South America

At Zigzag, you will become a pivotal member of our team, working alongside industry leading experts and delivering our client’s quality assurance aspirations and outcomes.


**Please submit your CV in English**


What we are looking for

  • Extensive auditing experience in GCP. Thorough knowledge of GCP.
  • Additional knowledge of another GxP areas (GLP, GCLP, GMP, CSV, PV) would be advantageous.
  • Able to confidently audit Investigator Sites with limited oversight.
  • Life science degree.
  • Strong client focus.


What Zigzag has to offer you

  • Leading Quality Assurance consultancy company – Our auditors work internationally across different types of organizations and audits and other QA related projects, with top thought-leaders in the industry. We are committed to continuous professional development.
  • Fostering Success in our Auditors - Scheduling to ensure you are able to deliver your best, every time.
  • A Truly Supportive and Management Team – Having a supportive and open leadership team allows our people to show up and be their best.
  • WiZe working schedule - Flexible working schedule to allow you to live your life around work.
  • A Competitive Compensation Package – We believe our people need to be compensated for their dedication.
  • Sustainability – We endeavour to keep auditors travel as local as possible to reduce our carbon footprint in line with our sustainability policy as well as ensuring you have a work/life balance.


What You’ll Do With Us

Auditors target will be to work to 70% utilisation, which could require up to 50% travel to client sites, that doesn’t mean you’ll be away from home for months at a time, as we ensure we schedule assignments for a fair work/life balance.


Our auditors are deployed to audit Investigator Sites and Vendors, as well as eTMF audits which are done remotely.


You’ll support our clients with Inspection Readiness and Inspection Management related activities across a diverse range of roles and regulatory bodies.


Who We Are

ZigZagQA is a trusted global leader in QA management, offering true global reach and unrivalled expertise to reduce risk and efforts. Working as an extension of our clients team, our experts increase capability and efficiency with collaborative, comprehensive and customized QA programs.


We partners with a wide range of clients across the entire drug discovery and development process to improve GxP Quality against global regulatory standards. We work with top 20 Pharmaceutical and Biotechnology companies, all the way to startups.


We strive for excellence, aiming to be the number one choice for our clients and our employees. We are passionate about Continuous Improvement and are always looking for a ‘better way’.

We are a global, quality leader who put people first and forge lasting relationships to bring deep impact in the industry.
