I confirm I have disclosed, if applicable, any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn, or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed.


By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Staffing Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Staffing Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who We Are


MAVI is on a mission to globalize the finance and accounting function by connecting the best talent in the world with high-performing US companies. We’re building the world’s largest network of top-tier finance talent, using an AI-powered platform for sourcing, vetting & matching, and disrupting a legacy $100Bn+ industry.



What the Platform Team Does at MAVI


Platform Management drives the strategic side of our recruiting ecosystem, interpreting client needs, aligning talent, and ensuring successful placements. The Platform team is responsible for running the core operations of MAVI’s talent marketplace. They manage the full journey, from understanding customer needs to matching talent, placing them in roles, and ensuring both sides have a great experience. Their work ensures the marketplace runs smoothly, efficiently, and with high-quality service.


About the Role


We’re hiring a Platform Specia list who can help drive the lifeblood of our talent marketplace - the end-to-end process from talent matching, talent placement & account management. This person will work directly with the current Platform Manager at MAVI and work as a tag team to close deals, manage ongoing engagements, resolve ad-hoc issues that arise, improve processes & work with the engineering team to inject automation into various workflows.



What You'll Do


  • Work with Leadership and the Platform Manager to understand job needs, ideal candidate profiles, and help match the right talent to open roles.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for MAVI customers , build trust, manage ongoing engagements, and keep them regularly updated.
  • Build strong, long-term relationships with customers by understanding their goals, preferences, and business needs.
  • Support the end-to-end matching process by reviewing candidate documentation and identifying best-fit talent for open positions.
  • Write compelling, clear, and engaging job descriptions to attract talent from our internal network and match them with active opportunities.
  • Assist in creating professional and polished candidate profiles for presentation to customers.
  • Provide support throughout the hiring process, ensuring consistent communication between talent and customers to keep things moving.
  • Resolve issues that arise during active engagements, ensuring alignment, satisfaction, and long-term success for both parties.
  • Collaborate with leadership and other internal teams to refine and enhance our account and engagement management processes.


What We’re Looking For


  • At least 4-9 years of experience in account management, staffing, recruitment coordination, or a related role.
  • Very strong English communication skills, both written and verbal, is a must.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, and customer relationships in a dynamic environment.
  • Proven ability to work in high-speed environments, to operate with high urgency, and be extremely customer-centric.
  • High level of discretion and judgment when handling confidential or sensitive information.
  • Experience working with global clients or in remote-first environments.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and adapt quickly to change.
  • Exceptional communication, organizational, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and strategic approach.
  • Someone who is humble, hungry and best in class at what they do.


Why You Should Join


  • Impact: You’re not just another cog in the machine; you’ll help build the talent acquisition motion ground up that powers the entire business.
  • No Bureaucracy: Work directly with founders, move fast, and own meaningful projects. We’re playing to win here. This is a startup and we’re looking for new ideas, bold moves, and scrappiness.
  • Competitive Pay: We believe in sharing the upside with those who build it :)
  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere, but expect high velocity and deep collaboration.


Equal Opportunity Statement


At MAVI, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applicants of every background, identity, and life experience. Employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Vacation Rental Revenue Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Vacation Rental Revenue Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're hiring a detail-oriented, numbers-driven Vacation Rental Revenue Manager to help Emperor Rentals improve pricing, occupancy, and revenue across our short-term rental portfolio.

$250 USD per week, paid weekly.

- Review property performance, pricing, occupancy, ADR, and revenue trends

- Your resume

- Your LinkedIn profile, if available

title: Contracting Manager, Activities Bank, Travel Industry
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Contracting Manager, Activities Bank, Travel Industry em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Contract Manager – Activities


About Us

At HBX Group , we are a global TravelTech ecosystem connecting and empowering businesses across the world of travel. Through data, innovation, and strong partnerships, we deliver seamless experiences and help our partners grow.

Within our Activities division, we focus on building competitive, high-quality product portfolios that meet evolving market demands. Our teams operate in a fast-paced, data-driven environment where ownership, adaptability, and collaboration are key to success.


Job Summary

As a Contract Manager , you will be responsible for managing and optimizing a portfolio of suppliers, ensuring the product remains competitive, available, and aligned with market needs.

This role combines supplier relationship management, negotiation, reporting, and operational execution , with a strong focus on performance tracking, prioritization, and continuous improvement . You will work closely with internal teams and external partners to drive revenue, maintain product quality, and unlock growth opportunities.


Job Responsibilities

Supplier & Portfolio Management

  • Manage a portfolio of Activities suppliers, ensuring product availability and competitiveness at all times.
  • Maintain and develop strong relationships with suppliers, acting as the main point of contact.
  • Ensure existing products remain optimized and aligned with market expectations.


Contracting & Negotiation

  • Negotiate commercial conditions including rates, inventory, offers, and contract terms.
  • Ensure renewal contracts are competitive and available in time to capture demand.
  • Benchmark competitors and proactively renegotiate where needed to maintain market positioning.


Performance Analysis & Reporting

  • Analyze portfolio performance through bi-weekly reports and statistics , identifying trends and opportunities.
  • Monitor KPIs and take actions to improve conversion, revenue, and product performance.
  • Provide insights and explanations on portfolio performance using data and market knowledge.


Operational Excellence

  • Manage multiple processes simultaneously, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and quality.
  • Prioritize tasks effectively based on business impact and deadlines.
  • Maintain updated product content (rates, inclusions, descriptions, availability).
  • Solve operational issues and coordinate solutions with internal teams and suppliers.


Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Work closely with internal stakeholders (Sales, Operations, Revenue, Product teams).
  • Support cross-functional initiatives and ensure alignment on commercial priorities.
  • Represent HBX Group in supplier meetings and market visits.


Required Skills

  • Strong prioritization and time management , with the ability to manage multiple processes simultaneously.
  • High level of analytical thinking , comfortable working with reports, data, and performance metrics.
  • Strong commercial mindset with negotiation capabilities.
  • Excellent relationship management and communication skills .
  • High attention to detail and process discipline, with flexibility to manage changing priorities.
  • Problem-solving mindset and ability to work independently.


Required Tech Skills

  • Intermediate Excel skills (data analysis, reporting, tracking KPIs).
  • Experience working with internal systems, contracting tools, or booking platforms .
  • Ability to analyze data and translate insights into actions.
  • Familiarity with reporting tools and dashboards is a plus.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 1–3+ years of experience in contracting, sourcing, account management, or similar roles.
  • Experience in travel, tourism, or supplier management is highly preferred.
  • Fluent in English, Spanish and Portuguese for communication with global teams.
  • Availability to travel as part of supplier relationship management.


At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference

title: Digital Ad Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Digital Ad Designer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle: from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As a Digital Ad Designer at Lilo Social, you will create scroll-stopping static graphics for Meta advertising campaigns while designing high-converting landing pages that drive measurable results for DTC brands. You will collaborate closely with creative strategists and media buyers to translate performance insights into compelling visual creative that captures attention and converts browsers into buyers.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent improvement in creative performance metrics (CTR, conversion rate, thumb-stop rate) across your client portfolio
  • Fast iteration speed that enables creative variations per week with maintained quality standards
  • High client satisfaction through on-brand designs that align with strategic creative direction
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration that accelerates testing velocity and produces scalable winning concepts


Responsibilities

  • Design high-performing static graphics for Meta ad campaigns across feed, stories, and reels formats
  • Create conversion-focused landing pages that align with ad messaging and drive customer action
  • Execute on creative briefs provided by strategists, translating concepts into visually compelling designs
  • Iterate quickly based on performance data, A/B test results, and stakeholder feedback
  • Maintain brand consistency and visual standards across multiple client accounts simultaneously
  • Design mobile-first experiences optimized for Meta's platform specifications and best practices
  • Organize and manage design files, asset libraries, and version control using established naming conventions
  • Collaborate with media buyers to understand campaign objectives and creative testing priorities
  • Stay current on Meta platform trends, ad formats, and direct response design principles
  • Produce landing page designs that integrate seamlessly with existing brand systems and conversion frameworks
  • Participate in creative reviews and provide design rationale grounded in performance marketing principles
  • Adapt existing creative concepts into new formats, sizes, and placements efficiently


Requirements

  • 3-4 years of design experience in performance marketing, advertising, or DTC ecommerce
  • Expert proficiency in Figma for design collaboration and file organization
  • Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop and Illustrator)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response creative and performance-focused design work
  • Proven experience designing ads specifically for Meta (Facebook and Instagram)
  • Understanding of mobile-first design principles and responsive layout techniques
  • Demonstrated ability to iterate quickly while maintaining high quality standards
  • Experience designing landing pages with conversion rate optimization in mind
  • Organized approach to file management with attention to naming conventions and version control
  • Comfort working with performance feedback and data-driven design decisions
  • Strong communication skills and ability to articulate design decisions
  • Self-starter mentality with ability to manage multiple client accounts and deadlines


Nice to Have

  • Motion graphics or animation skills with proficiency in After Effects or similar tools
  • Experience with landing page builders (Unbounce, Instapage, Replo, Shogun)
  • Understanding of Meta Ads Manager and campaign performance metrics
  • Experience working in an agency environment with multiple simultaneous client accounts
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce product page design
  • Knowledge of direct response copywriting principles and how they inform design hierarchy
  • Experience designing for additional platforms (TikTok, Google Display, YouTube)


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere on EST to PST hours with a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

You’ll work closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, and the creator community to identify opportunities, validate ideas, and ensure our product solves real user problems. title: Reiseberater:in Brasilien (Freelance, vor Ort)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Reiseberater:in Brasilien (Freelance, vor Ort) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Travel Buddies

Wir sind ein Team, das in den Destinationen lebt, die wir verkaufen. Unsere Buddies in Kuba, Vietnam und Namibia planen jede Reise selbst und betreuen die Gäste vor Ort. Das ist der Grund, warum Leute bei uns buchen.


Wir arbeiten direkt mit lokalen Partnern, ohne Zwischenhändler. DRSF-zertifiziert, Trustpilot 4,9/5, bekannt aus WELT und Handelsblatt. Jetzt bauen wir Brasilien auf. Du wärst die erste Person dafür.


Was du machst

Du lebst in Brasilien und kennst das Land aus deinem Alltag, deinen Freundschaften, deiner Arbeit. Du hast zwei Aufgaben bei uns:


Du sprichst mit deutschsprachigen Reisenden, die bei uns einen Beratungstermin gebucht haben. Du verstehst, was sie wollen, und planst mit uns gemeinsam ihre Reise — Routen, Unterkünfte, Erlebnisse. Du bist die Stimme aus Brasilien, wir bauen das Angebot daraus.


Wenn deine Gäste in Brasilien ankommen, bist du ihr Ansprechpartner. Per WhatsApp, im Call, manchmal persönlich. Du löst Probleme, wenn der Inlandsflug nach Salvador gestrichen wird oder die Pousada überbucht ist. Du organisierst Begegnungen, die im Reiseführer nicht stehen — die Köchin für deine Moqueca, den Jangadeiro mit seinem Segelfloß im Nordosten, den Musiker in der Roda de Samba, den Capoeira-Lehrer, den du persönlich kennst.


Du arbeitest 1:1 mit deinen Gästen. Dein Job ist, sie über dein Netzwerk und deine Geschichte mit dem Land zu verbinden.


Was du mitbringen musst

  • Du lebst seit mehreren Jahren in Brasilien. Mit Alltag, Freundeskreis, festen Strukturen.
  • Deutsch auf Muttersprache- oder C1-Niveau. Die Beratung läuft auf Deutsch.
  • Du hast eine eigene Geschichte mit dem Land. Warum bist du gekommen, was hält dich.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig und bist gut erreichbar — per WhatsApp und im Video-Call.


Was zusätzlich hilft

  • Portugiesisch-Kenntnisse
  • Englisch fließend
  • Erfahrung in Tourismus, Hospitality oder Beratung
  • Ein eigenes Netzwerk an Hotels, Pousadas, Drivern, Köchen
  • Vertrautheit mit CRM, Google Workspace, WhatsApp Business
  • Zugang zu Menschen, die einen Gast persönlich beeindrucken: Köche, Musiker, Fischer, Capoeira-Lehrer, Flussbootskapitäne im Amazonas


Was wir bieten

  • Freelance-Vertrag mit flexiblen Stunden. Als Nebentätigkeit gedacht für jemanden, der ohnehin im Land lebt.
  • Vergütung auf Stundenbasis plus Boni für Buchungen und gute Bewertungen.
  • Du baust eine Destination von null auf und prägst, wie wir Brasilien machen.
  • Ein eingespieltes Team im Rücken: Buchungen, Verträge, Tools, Versicherung. Du machst das, was nur du kannst.
  • Langfristige Zusammenarbeit über Jahre.

    • Eine Frage in deiner Bewerbung: Welchen Ort oder welche Begegnung in Brasilien könntest du möglich machen, die ein Tourist allein nie findet?

title: Reiseberater:in Brasilien (Freelance, vor Ort)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Reiseberater:in Brasilien (Freelance, vor Ort) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Travel Buddies

Wir sind ein Team, das in den Destinationen lebt, die wir verkaufen. Unsere Buddies in Kuba, Vietnam und Namibia planen jede Reise selbst und betreuen die Gäste vor Ort. Das ist der Grund, warum Leute bei uns buchen.


Wir arbeiten direkt mit lokalen Partnern, ohne Zwischenhändler. DRSF-zertifiziert, Trustpilot 4,9/5, bekannt aus WELT und Handelsblatt. Jetzt bauen wir Brasilien auf. Du wärst die erste Person dafür.


Was du machst

Du lebst in Brasilien und kennst das Land aus deinem Alltag, deinen Freundschaften, deiner Arbeit. Du hast zwei Aufgaben bei uns:


Du sprichst mit deutschsprachigen Reisenden, die bei uns einen Beratungstermin gebucht haben. Du verstehst, was sie wollen, und planst mit uns gemeinsam ihre Reise — Routen, Unterkünfte, Erlebnisse. Du bist die Stimme aus Brasilien, wir bauen das Angebot daraus.


Wenn deine Gäste in Brasilien ankommen, bist du ihr Ansprechpartner. Per WhatsApp, im Call, manchmal persönlich. Du löst Probleme, wenn der Inlandsflug nach Salvador gestrichen wird oder die Pousada überbucht ist. Du organisierst Begegnungen, die im Reiseführer nicht stehen — die Köchin für deine Moqueca, den Jangadeiro mit seinem Segelfloß im Nordosten, den Musiker in der Roda de Samba, den Capoeira-Lehrer, den du persönlich kennst.


Du arbeitest 1:1 mit deinen Gästen. Dein Job ist, sie über dein Netzwerk und deine Geschichte mit dem Land zu verbinden.


Was du mitbringen musst

  • Du lebst seit mehreren Jahren in Brasilien. Mit Alltag, Freundeskreis, festen Strukturen.
  • Deutsch auf Muttersprache- oder C1-Niveau. Die Beratung läuft auf Deutsch.
  • Du hast eine eigene Geschichte mit dem Land. Warum bist du gekommen, was hält dich.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig und bist gut erreichbar — per WhatsApp und im Video-Call.


Was zusätzlich hilft

  • Portugiesisch-Kenntnisse
  • Englisch fließend
  • Erfahrung in Tourismus, Hospitality oder Beratung
  • Ein eigenes Netzwerk an Hotels, Pousadas, Drivern, Köchen
  • Vertrautheit mit CRM, Google Workspace, WhatsApp Business
  • Zugang zu Menschen, die einen Gast persönlich beeindrucken: Köche, Musiker, Fischer, Capoeira-Lehrer, Flussbootskapitäne im Amazonas


Was wir bieten

  • Freelance-Vertrag mit flexiblen Stunden. Als Nebentätigkeit gedacht für jemanden, der ohnehin im Land lebt.
  • Vergütung auf Stundenbasis plus Boni für Buchungen und gute Bewertungen.
  • Du baust eine Destination von null auf und prägst, wie wir Brasilien machen.
  • Ein eingespieltes Team im Rücken: Buchungen, Verträge, Tools, Versicherung. Du machst das, was nur du kannst.
  • Langfristige Zusammenarbeit über Jahre.

    • Eine Frage in deiner Bewerbung: Welchen Ort oder welche Begegnung in Brasilien könntest du möglich machen, die ein Tourist allein nie findet?

description:

TDLR : Pocket FM is hiring remote freelance Brazilian Portuguese Voice Over Artists with professional home studios for long-term, serialized audio fiction. The role requires native fluency and the capacity to deliver 20 to 40 hours of recorded content monthly on a per-hour paid basis.


Voice Over Artist (Brazilian Portuguese)


About Pocket FM


Pocket FM is the world’s leading audio storytelling platform, reaching over 200 million listeners across more than 20 countries. We combine human creativity and innovative technology to create immersive audio series enjoyed by millions of listeners worldwide.


As we expand our Portuguese content library, we are looking for talented, professional Brazilian Voice Over Artists to join our global network of creators.


Role Overview


As a Freelance Voice Over Artist, you will bring complex characters and gripping stories to life in serialized audio fiction. You will collaborate remotely with our production, writing, and quality teams to deliver highly engaging, emotionally authentic performances for long-form series.


This is a remote, contract-based freelance opportunity offering a consistent monthly pipeline of work for a long-term collaboration.


Requirements


  • Native Fluency: Native Brazilian Portuguese speaker with the ability to perform in Neutral Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Versatility & Acting Chops: Strong acting, dubbing, or storytelling skills, with the ability to portray diverse characters across a wide range of ages and emotional profiles.
  • Proven Experience: Background in voice acting, dubbing, audiobook narration, audio drama, or podcasting.
  • Studio Setup: A professional home recording studio environment with a high-quality microphone and reliable, high-speed internet.
  • Capacity: Availability to record and deliver up to 20-40 hours of recorded content per month, while maintaining weekly delivery schedules.
  • Collaboration: Openness to taking performance direction and participating in necessary retakes/feedback sessions.


Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with basic audio editing and file management
  • Experience working remotely with production teams


Engagement Details

  • Contract Type: Freelance / Independent Contractor
  • Location: Remote (Work from your own studio)
  • Compensation: Paid monthly on an hours delivered basis.

How to Apply : Please fill in


What happens after you apply?


Our Casting & Production Process : Here is a look at our step-by-step collaboration pipeline:

1.Internal Evaluation:

Our production team will carefully review your voice demos, studio specs, and portfolio to see if your vocal profile matches our upcoming projects.

2.Show Casting & Voice Testing:

If your profile fits, we will invite you to a voice test for the specific audio series we are casting. This helps us ensure your performance aligns perfectly with the character's vision.

3.Contract & Legal Alignment:

Once selected for a show, we will finalize a freelance legal agreement. This contract will clearly outline the voice usage rights for the series and formalize our agreed monthly payment terms.

4.Calibration & Onboarding:

Before the official recording begins, we will run a brief calibration session. This ensures your studio's audio mastering levels match our technical delivery standards for a seamless workflow.

5.Production & Monthly Deliveries:

Recording begins! Our long-form audio series typically span 150 to 300 hours in total. We partner with you for the long haul, expecting a steady delivery of 20 to 40 hours of recorded content per month until the series is complete.

You will work across application code, database architecture, and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to deliver scalable, reliable systems.

Database Architecture, Performance & Ownership  

  • Design, evolve, and optimize database schemas, indexes, queries, and stored procedures  to support high-performance application workloads 
  • Own database performance tuning , query optimization, and capacity planning across environments 
  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability  strategies in Azure SQL

  • Own database cost management  in Azure, including sizing, scaling strategies, and cost optimization

Software Development & Feature Delivery

  • Build application features that interact deeply with the database , balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability 
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs  and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems 
  • Participate in architectural discussions  and influence technical direction across the stack 
  • Perform code reviews  and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers 


Azure Cloud & DevOps  

  • Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure , with a focus on reliability and observability 
  • Support CI/CD pipelines  and deployment practices using Azure DevOps 
  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution 
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost 


Required Qualifications  


Experience & Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience 
  • 7+ years  of professional experience in C#/.NET software development 
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency) 


Technical Skills (Priority Order)  

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise , including: 

Advanced T-SQL 

Stored procedures and query optimization 

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis 

Performance tuning and troubleshooting 

  • Proven experience owning database operations , including: 

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery 

Performance monitoring and scaling 

  • Cost and capacity management in Azure 
  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework  
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs  
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services , including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)  
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum  development methodologies 
  • Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps  

Soft Skills  

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems 
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability 
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams 

Bonus Points  

  • Microsoft Azure certifications (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect, or similar) 
  • Experience with Plivo or Twilio

What We Offer

title: Head of Risk (Crypto)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Risk (Crypto) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Head of Risk (Crypto) (Brazil-based)


About the Company:

We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet — and we're looking for exceptional finance professionals to help shape it.


The Role:

We are in search of a business-oriented Head of Risk (Crypto) to lead the overall risk management function for our Brazil entity.


This role focuses on end-to-end risk management across trading, financial crime, and product risk, while ensuring the company operates within its defined risk appetite while actively supporting business growth.


Unlike traditional compliance-heavy roles, this position is about risk ownership: identifying exposures, calibrating tolerance, and driving real-time control execution. We're looking for someone who understands that well-designed risk frameworks are a business enabler, not a brake.


We welcome candidates with a strong crypto or digital asset background. We are equally open to risk leaders from traditional financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, or payments companies who bring deep, transferable expertise and a genuine appetite to operate in a more dynamic, high-growth environment.


What You'll Do:

  • Establish and lead the company's enterprise-wide risk management framework, covering trading and market risk, product risk, financial crime risk, and operational risk.
  • Define, review, and continuously optimise the risk appetite framework in alignment with overall business strategy.
  • Monitor risk activities to ensure alignment with internal risk policies, business objectives, and applicable Brazilian regulatory expectations, and other relevant regulatory authorities.
  • Partner with senior leadership and the Board to embed risk-informed thinking into strategic decision-making.
  • Build and enhance risk control mechanisms across transaction monitoring and risk indicators, market surveillance controls, and product risk assessment frameworks.
  • Identify and stay ahead of emerging risks in trading, product design, and operations, and lead mitigation strategies.
  • Strengthen internal control systems and drive effective risk governance across the organisation.
  • Support the company's ongoing regulatory engagement and risk governance as Brazil's digital asset regulatory framework continues to evolve.


What We're Looking For:

  • 10+ years of risk management experience within crypto, financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, payments, or digital asset businesses.
  • Deep expertise in enterprise risk management, including risk appetite frameworks, governance, and internal controls.
  • Strong understanding of trading, transaction, and financial crime risks, with the ability to balance effective risk management against commercial objectives.
  • Ability to translate risk frameworks into practical controls and work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Operations to implement them.
  • Proven track record operating at or reporting to Executive Committee and Board level.
  • Strategic thinker with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders and embed a strong risk culture across the organisation spanning across operational, market and liquidity risk.
  • Expert understanding of Brazilian regulatory expectations relating to financial institutions and digital asset service providers.
  • Crypto or digital asset experience is strongly preferred, but we also welcome candidates from traditional financial services with strong transferable risk expertise and a genuine interest in the digital asset sector.
  • Functional knowledge of digital asset or digital token listing processes is preferred.

description:

Na NTT DATA Business Solutions, impulsionamos a inovação – desde consultoria e implementação até serviços gerenciados e além, impulsionados por uma equipe global e mais de 18.500 especialistas representando mais de 90 nações em mais de 30 países. Conosco, você tem infinitas oportunidades para pensar grande, agir com ousadia e assumir a responsabilidade. Faça deste o lugar onde você pertence, aprende e constrói sua rede.


Make this the place where you grow!


Buscamos um(a) SAP Solution Architect com sólida experiência técnica em SAP Basis, certificação SAP PCA e atuação como especialista em arquiteturas SAP em ambientes hyperscaler certificados, para apoiar projetos estratégicos de System Move, Migration e Upgrades, além de iniciativas de pré‑vendas. Esse profissional será responsável por definir, validar e governar arquiteturas técnicas SAP em ambientes on‑premise, cloud e híbridos, assegurando viabilidade técnica, segurança, performance, escalabilidade e total aderência às melhores práticas e recomendações oficiais da SAP.


Principais Responsabilidades:



  • Definir e desenhar arquiteturas técnicas SAP para projetos de:
  • System Move (on‑premise ↔ cloud / datacenter); System Migration (ECC para S/4HANA, conversões técnicas e transformações de landscape); Upgrades SAP (tecnológicos e funcionais).
  • Atuar como especialista em arquiteturas SAP em hyperscalers certificados SAP, garantindo conformidade com padrões de:
  • Disponibilidade; Segurança; Performance; Escalabilidade.
  • Exercer o papel de arquiteto técnico e referência SAP Basis em projetos SAP de média e alta complexidade.
  • Apoiar processos de pré‑vendas, incluindo:
  • Análise de requisitos técnicos; Definição da arquitetura de solução;
  • Avaliação de riscos, premissas e dependências técnicas; Estimativas de esforço e definição da abordagem técnica;
  • Participação em reuniões com clientes e apresentações executivas.
  • Avaliar impactos técnicos relacionados a:
  • Migração e saneamento de dados;
  • Integrações SAP e sistemas legados;
  • Performance, alta disponibilidade, segurança e continuidade operacional.
  • Garantir aderência às boas práticas SAP, recomendações oficiais e padrões corporativos de arquitetura.
  • Apoiar equipes funcionais e técnicas na tomada de decisões arquiteturais ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida dos projetos.


Requisitos:


  • Certificação SAP PCA (perfil SAP Basis).
  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de Move, Migration e Upgrades SAP.
  • Atuação como especialista em arquiteturas SAP em hyperscalers certificados SAP.
  • Conhecimento sólido em: SAP S/4HANA; Arquitetura SAP on‑premise, cloud e híbrida; Ambientes hyperscaler certificados SAP; Integrações SAP; Landscapes SAP, governança técnica e migração de dados.
  • Forte capacidade de análise, identificação e mitigação de riscos técnicos.


Diferenciais:


  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com habilidade para interação com públicos técnicos e executivos.
  • Perfil consultivo, com visão end‑to‑end e forte orientação à solução.
  • Experiência prévia em pré‑vendas SAP.
  • Vivência em projetos SAP de grande porte e ambientes críticos.
  • Experiência em apresentações executivas e condução de workshops técnicos.



Regime de Contratação: Modelo de CLT

title: Head of Compliance (Brazil resident)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Compliance (Brazil resident) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the company

We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet.


Why this role

We are entering the Brazilian market as a Banco Central do Brasil-authorised Virtual Asset Service Provider, and you would be our first Head of Compliance on the ground. The authorisation itself depends on having someone the BCB trusts in this seat — someone who treats AML/CFT, KYC, and disclosure as the actual job, not paperwork around it. In your first year, you will have stood up the compliance program the regulator expects to see and built the company's track record with the BCB from zero.


What you'll do

  • Hold statutory officer responsibility for compliance at a BCB-authorised VASP, with personal accountability for acting in good faith and in the company's best interest
  • Own the design and effectiveness of the AML/CFT and KYC program, including transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, and suspicious activity reporting
  • Act as the primary point of contact with the BCB and COAF for compliance matters, including audits, inspections, and ad hoc information requests
  • Maintain personal fitness and propriety; disclose, without prompting, anything that touches your fitness, propriety, or potential conflicts — to the company and to the BCB
  • Drive the VASP authorisation process forward on the compliance workstream, including declarations and documentation the BCB requests on its own timeline


What you'll bring

Must-have

  • Brazilian permanent residency or citizenship, with the ability to maintain ordinary residency in Brazil for as long as the role requires
  • You hold no competing officer or director seat at another regulated entity in Brazil
  • Direct compliance experience at a BCB-regulated institution (bank, securities broker/distributor, foreign exchange dealer) or at a crypto exchange/VASP
  • Hands-on ownership of AML/CFT and KYC programs, not just oversight of someone else's
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, written and spoken
  • Willing to undergo a full BCB fit-and-proper review and disclose what it requires


Nice-to-have

  • Prior compliance experience specifically within a crypto exchange or VASP
  • AML/compliance certification (e.g. CAMS, ICA)
  • Direct prior engagement with BCB or COAF on audits, inspections, or filings

title: Senior VIP Relationship Specialist, Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior VIP Relationship Specialist, Brazil em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and driven Senior VIP Relationship Specialist to join our VIP team in Brazil. In this senior role, you will serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for our high-value clients in the region. You will be responsible for elevating the customer experience, fostering long-term client loyalty, and leading localized initiatives to drive business success and market share within the Brazilian and broader LATAM crypto ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

  • Portfolio Management & Acquisition: Drive client acquisition and deliver high-touch relationship management for a dedicated portfolio of premium institutional and high-net-worth (HNW) clients in Brazil.
  • Relationship & Engagement: Build strong rapport and trust with existing VIP clients through frequent, personalized, and sustained communication, ensuring high retention and platform loyalty.
  • Process Optimization: Take ownership of designing and optimizing key customer service processes and systems tailored to the local market, establishing management rules, and tracking the life-cycle status of key accounts.
  • Data-Driven Analysis: Analyze client trading behaviors, identify unspoken or sophisticated needs, and prepare comprehensive key customer analysis reports to inform localized product and service strategies.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the strategic liaison between Brazil VIP clients and internal stakeholders (Product, Compliance, Operations, and Tech teams) to deliver optimal, seamless, and compliant service solutions.

Qualifications

  • Proven Track Record: A well-established client network in Brazil/LATAM, including institutional clients, high-net-worth individuals (HNWIs), family offices, private banking clients, brokers, or futures institutions.
  • Industry Experience: Direct experience working within crypto trading platforms, digital asset exchanges, or fintech pioneers is highly advantageous.
  • Financial Background: Minimum of 4-6 years of prior experience in sales, account management, or client services within international financial institutions, commercial/private banking, or asset management.
  • Language Proficiency: Native or bilingual fluency in Portuguese (both written and spoken) is mandatory, along with professional proficiency in English for cross-border corporate communication.
  • Adaptability & Resilience: Proven ability to thrive under pressure, manage tight deadlines, and excel in a fast-paced, multi-tasking environment.
  • Crypto Passion: Demonstrates a deep enthusiasm for the web3 and cryptocurrency industry, with a sharp understanding of the latest trends, regulatory shifts, and innovations in the Brazilian market.

Contract

title: Head of Finance- Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Finance- Brazil em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About VelaFi

At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we help businesses move money across borders faster, more securely, and more efficiently by connecting local banking rails, global payment networks, and leading stablecoin ecosystems through regulated entities across Latin America, Asia, and the United States.


Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability.


Position Overview

VelaFi is seeking an experienced Chief Financial Officer (CFO) – Brazil to lead the financial strategy, governance, and regulatory reporting of the company's Brazilian VASP entity.

Reporting directly to the Global Finance Leadership Team, the CFO will oversee accounting, treasury, financial planning and analysis (FP&A), tax coordination, regulatory reporting, financial controls, and banking relationships across Brazil. This executive will play a key role in supporting VelaFi's continued expansion by building scalable financial infrastructure, ensuring compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements, and providing strategic financial leadership to the business.


The ideal candidate combines deep financial expertise, executive leadership, and experience operating within regulated financial services organizations, with the ability to build scalable processes and support a rapidly growing global fintech company. The CFO will also play a critical role in ensuring compliance with Brazil's financial regulatory reporting framework, including executive oversight of COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, and Unicad (IN BCB 712/713) reporting obligations, while partnering closely with Compliance, Legal, and executive leadership.


Location

Remote – Brazil

Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required.


Key Responsibilities

Financial Leadership

  • Lead all accounting, finance, treasury, tax, and financial planning activities for the Brazil entity.
  • Develop and execute the company's financial strategy in alignment with global objectives.
  • Establish scalable financial processes, reporting frameworks, and governance standards.
  • Provide financial insights and recommendations to executive leadership.

Financial Reporting & Regulatory Compliance

  • Oversee the preparation of accurate financial statements and regulatory reports.
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian accounting standards, tax requirements, and applicable financial regulations.
  • Lead and oversee all regulatory financial reporting obligations, including COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, and Unicad reporting (IN BCB 712/713), ensuring timely and accurate submissions to BACEN and other applicable regulatory authorities.
  • Support VASP licensing requirements and ongoing regulatory reporting obligations.
  • Coordinate external audits and manage relationships with auditors, the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN), and other regulatory authorities.
  • Maintain strong financial governance while ensuring compliance with evolving regulatory requirements.

Treasury & Banking

  • Oversee treasury operations, liquidity management, cash flow forecasting, and banking relationships.
  • Monitor financial performance, capital allocation, and funding requirements.
  • Support payment operations, FX management, and cross-border transaction activities.
  • Partner with Treasury and Operations teams to optimize financial infrastructure.

Financial Controls & Risk Management

  • Establish and maintain strong internal controls, accounting policies, and financial governance.
  • Ensure compliance with corporate policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Support enterprise risk management initiatives in partnership with Compliance and Risk leadership.
  • Drive continuous improvement of financial systems and reporting processes.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with Compliance, Operations, Product, Treasury, Legal, Commercial, and Executive Leadership.
  • Support strategic business initiatives, market expansion, and corporate planning.
  • Collaborate with global Finance teams to ensure consistent financial reporting and operational alignment.

Organizational Development

  • Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing finance professionals.
  • Build a scalable finance organization capable of supporting rapid business growth.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
  • CPA, CRC, or equivalent professional accounting qualification preferred.
  • MBA or advanced finance qualification is a plus.
  • 10+ years of progressive finance leadership experience within fintech, banking, payments, financial services, or related industries.
  • Strong experience leading accounting, treasury, financial reporting, and regulatory compliance functions.
  • Experience working with auditors, regulators, financial institutions, and executive leadership.
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian financial regulations, accounting standards, and tax requirements.
  • Experience preparing or overseeing COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713) reporting, and other regulatory submissions required by Brazilian financial authorities is strongly preferred.
  • Exceptional analytical, leadership, and communication skills.
  • Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English.

Desired Competencies

  • Regulatory reporting expertise, including COSIF, SCE-IED, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713), and BACEN compliance

Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, payments, digital assets, stablecoins, or blockchain technology.
  • Experience with multi-entity and multi-currency financial operations.
  • Experience working with ERP platforms such as NetSuite.
  • Experience supporting regulated financial institutions or VASPs.
  • Knowledge of cross-border payments, FX operations, and treasury infrastructure.
  • Experience working within multinational or global organizations.
  • Hands-on experience with COSIF accounting, SCE-IED reporting, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713), and other BACEN regulatory reporting requirements.


Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP)

Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including:

  • Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil.
  • Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities.
  • Hold any professional registrations or licenses required under Brazilian law to perform the responsibilities of the position, where applicable.
  • Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence.
  • Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws.
  • Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment.
  • Not have been declared bankrupt or legally insolvent.
  • Not have been suspended or prohibited from serving as an executive of regulated financial institutions.
  • Meet any additional \"fit and proper\" requirements established by the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN) and other applicable regulatory authorities.


Why Join VelaFi?

Joining VelaFi means helping build the next generation of global financial infrastructure.

As Chief Financial Officer – Brazil , you will play a foundational role in establishing the financial governance and regulatory reporting framework for one of VelaFi's most strategic international markets. You'll work directly with executive leadership to oversee finance, treasury, regulatory reporting, and compliance while helping build a scalable financial organization that supports the company's long-term growth and Brazil VASP operations.


This is an opportunity to shape the financial future of a high-growth fintech company operating at the intersection of traditional finance, digital assets, and cross-border payments.


Equal Employment Opportunity

VelaFi is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Country Manager- Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Country Manager- Brazil em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About VelaFi


At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we help businesses move money across borders faster, more securely, and more efficiently by connecting local banking rails, global payment networks, and leading stablecoin ecosystems through regulated entities across Latin America, Asia, and the United States.


Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability.


Position Overview

VelaFi is seeking an experienced Chief Executive Officer (CEO) – Brazil to lead the company's Brazilian operations and serve as the statutory executive responsible for the local VASP entity.

Reporting directly to the Global Executive Leadership Team, the CEO will be responsible for the overall leadership, strategic direction, regulatory engagement, commercial growth, and operational performance of VelaFi Brazil. This individual will play a critical role in establishing the company's presence in Brazil, leading local market expansion, fostering relationships with regulators and financial institutions, and ensuring compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements.


The ideal candidate combines executive leadership experience, strong commercial acumen, operational excellence, and the ability to lead a highly regulated financial services organization in a fast-growing global fintech environment. The CEO will also play a pivotal role in leading VelaFi Brazil's regulatory establishment, including executive oversight of the BACEN registration process and collaboration on the company's Brazil VASP licensing process, working closely with Compliance, Legal, and global leadership.


Location

Remote – Brazil

Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required.


Key Responsibilities

Executive Leadership

  • Lead the overall strategy, growth, and operational performance of VelaFi Brazil.
  • Build and develop the local leadership team and organizational structure.
  • Establish operational excellence while ensuring alignment with global company objectives.
  • Drive execution across Commercial, Operations, Finance, Compliance, and Product functions.

Regulatory & Corporate Governance

  • Serve as the primary executive representative before Brazilian regulatory authorities.
  • Maintain strong relationships with the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN) , financial institutions, banking partners, and other regulatory stakeholders.
  • Lead the company's BACEN registration process, ensuring timely execution of regulatory requirements and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Provide executive oversight and collaborate closely with Compliance, Legal, and global leadership throughout the Brazil VASP licensing process, supporting regulatory submissions, licensing milestones, and ongoing compliance efforts.
  • Ensure ongoing compliance with applicable VASP, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.
  • Support ongoing regulatory reporting, licensing renewals, and corporate governance initiatives.

Commercial Growth & Strategic Partnerships

  • Develop and execute the company's go-to-market strategy in Brazil.
  • Build strategic partnerships with banks, payment service providers (PSPs), fintechs, enterprise customers, and ecosystem partners.
  • Identify new business opportunities and support revenue growth.
  • Represent VelaFi at executive meetings, conferences, and industry events.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with Finance, Compliance, Treasury, Product, Operations, Legal, and Commercial teams.
  • Foster collaboration across global teams located in LATAM, APAC, and North America.
  • Drive organizational alignment and operational efficiency across all business functions.

Organizational Development

  • Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing teams.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Support workforce planning and organizational scaling as the business grows.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Law, or a related field.
  • MBA or other advanced degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of executive leadership experience within fintech, banking, payments, financial services, or related industries.
  • Proven experience leading business operations and organizational growth.
  • Strong understanding of Brazil's financial services and regulatory environment.
  • Experience working with regulators, banking institutions, and executive stakeholders.
  • Experience leading or supporting regulatory licensing, authorization, or registration processes with Brazilian financial regulators (including BACEN or VASP frameworks) is strongly preferred.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and decision-making skills.
  • Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English.


Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, payments, digital assets, stablecoins, or blockchain technology.
  • Experience launching or scaling financial services businesses in Brazil.
  • Existing relationships with Brazilian regulators, financial institutions, and payment providers.
  • Experience working within multinational or global organizations.
  • Experience with cross-border payments and treasury infrastructure.
  • Experience leading or supporting BACEN registration, financial institution licensing, or Brazil VASP authorization initiatives.


Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP)

Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including:

  • Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil.
  • Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities.
  • Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence.
  • Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws.
  • Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment.


Why Join VelaFi?

At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we connect local banking rails, global payment networks, and digital asset infrastructure to enable faster, more secure, and more efficient cross-border money movement.

Joining VelaFi means playing a foundational leadership role in establishing our regulated presence in Brazil while helping shape one of the company's most strategic growth markets. You'll work alongside global executive leadership to build a scalable business, lead critical regulatory initiatives, and help create the financial infrastructure powering the next generation of global payments.


Guided by our values of Ingenuity, Accountability, Excellence, Care, and a Global Mindset , we empower our leaders to solve meaningful challenges, take ownership, and build lasting impact across global financial markets.

title: Gerente De Vendas
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Gerente De Vendas em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

CARREIRAS PARA SORRIR Na PepsiCo, você descobrirá um lugar onde nossa missão é criar sorrisos em todo o mundo. Com um portfólio de mais de 500 marcas adoradas, incluindo Gatorade, Lay’s e Quaker, nosso trabalho toca milhões de pessoas todos os dias.No coração da empresa está uma equipe de pensadores, criadores e solucionadores de problemas que colaboram para inovar e transformar ideias em ação. Impulsionados pela inovação e pelo foco em criar momentos de alegria por meio de alimentos e bebidas, nossas decisões são guiadas pela centralidade no consumidor, criando oportunidades para que nossos associados realizem um trabalho significativo e gerem um impacto duradouro nas comunidades que atendemos.Seja qual for o seu papel, você fará parte de uma comunidade global que valoriza suas ideias e o capacita a causar impacto, tanto em sua carreira quanto no mundo ao seu redor.A oportunidade - Responsável pelo planejamento, gestão e controle das operações comerciais no mercado onde atua, visando atingir as previsões de faturamento nos limites de despesas previstas no orçamento; - Planeja, organiza e gerencia as ações dos clientes sob sua responsabilidade, desenvolvendo estratégias e ações para alcançar e/ou superar os objetivos estabelecidos pela Cia., respeitando a política comercial e mantendo o crescimento sustentável de sua unidade de negócios; - Assegurar o desenvolvimento dos recursos humanos sob sua responsabilidade; - Atuar com base nos Valores, Princípios e Código de Conduta.O seu impacto - Representar a empresa no desenvolvimento das relações comerciais com os principais clientes da companhia; - Atingir periodicamente os objetivos de volume, respeitando as políticas comerciais, e metas internas da Companhia; - Manter a empresa informada sobre as ações de mercado, a fim de alimentar nossas ferramentas gerenciais e indicadores chave de performance; - Analisar regularmente as ferramentas internas disponíveis além dos demais relatórios diversos de kpi´s, fornecidos pelas áreas de apoio, conectando os dados com as análises de mercado obtidas de store check, visitas comerciais e relatórios Nielsen, para identificar oportunidades e propor soluções, formalizadas em um plano de ação; - Analisar os indicadores de performance do desempenho dos seus clientes para tomada de decisões; - Desenvolver a equipe sob sua responsabilidade direta seguindo o Modelo de Desenvolvimento de Carreira da PepsiCo.- Planejar e acompanhar as entregas, com negociações de volume adequadas às regras de palletização e com o melhor faseamento dentro do mês, contribuindo para solucionar/ eliminar dificuldades de entrega e devoluções de mercadorias; - Desenvolver o Modelo de Gestão Pepsico para sua região dentro da sua respectiva área de atuação, conhecendo adequadamente seu cliente e atuando como parceiro de negócio; - Desenvolver calendário de atividades promocionais alinhado com as estratégias da empresa, gerenciando acordos (contratos) comerciais para garantir o crescimento dos volumes negociados, bem como também fortalecer a parceria comercial; - Garantir cadastro dos produtos nos clientes sob sua responsabilidade e manter a equipe de execução informada a respeito do status do cadastramento; - Garantir que seus clientes estejam operando com o mix de produtos adequados para a região; - Propor inclusãode novos clientes importantes em sua região; - Acompanhar periodicamente a situação de crédito de seus clientes junto ao departamento de crédito e cobrança, e informar qualquer anormalidade financeira dos mesmos.Quem estamos buscando? - Formação/Curso: Superior completo em áreas relacionadas à função.- Experiência sólida na na área de Vendas de bens de consumo, com clientes de pequeno e médio varejo, preferencialmente no ramo de alimentos, atuando como gestor de equipe direta.- Pacote Office: Intermediário- Disponibilidade para viagens (rota, viagens curtas)- Experiência com sistema SAP (diferencial)Se esta é uma oportunidade que te interessa, te encorajamos a se candidatar mesmo que não atenda a 100% dos requisitos.O que você pode esperar da gente?Na PepsiCo, queremos recompensar da melhor forma o seu desempenho e trabalho, cuidando sempre do seu bem-estar integral. Por isso, oferecemos:Remuneração competitiva, com componentes fixos e variáveis que permitirão alcançar suas metas financeiras.Um programa de flexibilidade que permitirá equilibrar melhor sua vida pessoal e profissional, adaptando seu horário de trabalho ao seu estilo de vida.Benefícios como seguros, telemedicina e check-up médico, para que você se mantenha sempre em seu melhor estado de saúde.Com nosso benefício de Auto Executivo, você poderá escolher entre um carro, que inclui também ajuda com combustível e manutenção;  ou um bônus de auxílio transporte (apenas para níveis gerenciais L10+).Um programa de bem, com diferentes iniciativas ao longo do ano, que ajudará a promover mais equilíbri o para a sua saúde física, mental e integral -.Programas que ajudarão a cuidar do seu bem-estar financeiro e a alcançar suas metas em todas as etapas da sua vida: Programa de Bem-Estar Financeiro, Caixa de Poupança, Fundo de Poupança e Previdência Privada.Adoramos celebrar o sucesso, por isso contamos com programas de reconhecimento por tempo de trabalho, comportamentos, liderança, momentos de vida, entre outros.E como sua família também é importante para nós, estendemos benefícios como nossa Linha de Bem-Estar, Convênios e Descontos, programas de Bolsas de Estudo para seus/suas filhos(as), Planos de Auxílios para diferentes momentos de vida, entre outros.Na PepsiCo, estamos comprometidos em promover uma equipe de trabalho diversa, criando um espaço colaborativo, equitativo e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas - independentemente de como nos parecemos, de onde viemos ou a quem amamos - tenham suas vozes ouvidas. Oferecemos igualdade de oportunidades e consideramos os(as) candidatos(as) para todos os cargos, sem distinção de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade ou deficiência.

title: CQV Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para CQV Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Vaga: Engenheiro(a) CQV – 100% Remoto | Brasil


Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Commissioning, Qualification & Validation (CQV) para atuar em um projeto internacional no setor farmacêutico.

A posição é 100% remota no Brasil , com interação diária com equipes globais e participação em projetos de alta complexidade para um cliente em forte expansão.


Principais responsabilidades :

  • Elaborar e executar protocolos de IQ, OQ e PQ para equipamentos, utilidades e sistemas.
  • Desenvolver documentação de qualificação e validação (protocolos, relatórios, análise de riscos e rastreabilidade).
  • Atuar em conjunto com Engenharia, Qualidade, Produção e Validação para garantir a conformidade dos projetos.
  • Apoiar investigações de desvios, CAPAs e atividades relacionadas à conformidade regulatória.
  • Garantir o atendimento aos requisitos de GMP , GAMP 5 e demais normas aplicáveis.
  • Participar de reuniões técnicas com equipes internacionais em inglês.


Requisitos :

  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em CQV na indústria farmacêutica, biotecnológica ou de dispositivos médicos.
  • Experiência prática na elaboração e execução de protocolos IQ, OQ e PQ .
  • Conhecimento de GMP , GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11 e/ou EU Annex 11.
  • Inglês fluente (obrigatório) .
  • Português fluente (obrigatório) .
  • Excelente comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma em ambiente remoto.


Diferenciais :

  • Experiência com utilidades críticas (HVAC, PW, WFI, Clean Steam, ar comprimido etc.).
  • Conhecimento em CSV/CSA.
  • Experiência em projetos de biotecnologia, vacinas ou produtos estéreis.
  • Vivência em projetos internacionais.


O que oferecemos :

title: Portuguese Language Expert
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Portuguese Language Expert em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for detail-oriented Freelance AI Trainers – Audio to support high-impact Generative AI data annotation projects involving PII identification and content risk assessment on raw audio inputs.

In this role, you will listen to and annotate raw audio content to identify personally identifiable information, assess risk signals, evaluate AI-generated outputs where applicable, and apply detailed project guidelines with precision. You will help create high-quality ground truth data used to train and improve advanced AI models.

This is a flexible, freelance engagement suited to individuals who want project-based work rather than a fixed weekly schedule. It requires strong listening comprehension, mature judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment where guidelines may evolve frequently.


Key Responsibilities

As an AI Trainer – Audio, you will:

  • Review and annotate raw audio content, including spoken conversations, calls, and other audio recordings.
  • Identify, classify, and assess personally identifiable information, sensitive data, and privacy-related risks conveyed through audio.
  • Perform risk assessment on audio content involving safety, policy compliance, sensitive topics, and contextual ambiguity.
  • Evaluate AI model outputs derived from audio for correctness, completeness, relevance, risk classification, and guideline adherence, where applicable.
  • Apply complex, frequently updated annotation guidelines consistently and with sound judgment.
  • Handle potentially sensitive, unsafe, or policy-sensitive audio content responsibly and professionally.
  • Manage own schedule and task throughput within agreed project deadlines and quality expectations.
  • Escalate ambiguous cases, guideline gaps, tooling issues, and edge cases to project leads or quality teams.
  • Collaborate remotely with Project Managers, Quality Analysts, and technical teams to improve annotation quality and workflow efficiency.


Required Language Proficiency

Candidates must demonstrate CEFR C1+ equivalent proficiency in their working language (English or the applicable target language). Bilingual proficiency is not required for this role.

Proficiency is required in:

  • Listening / Understanding (primary requirement, given the audio-based nature of the task)
  • Reading comprehension (for guideline interpretation and task instructions)
  • Basic written composition (for annotation notes and escalation of edge cases)

The role requires the ability to understand nuanced spoken language, accents, cultural context, idiomatic expressions, policy-sensitive language, and subtle differences in meaning conveyed through audio.


Required Experience

The ideal candidate should have prior hands-on experience in one or more of the following annotation areas:

  • PII identification or privacy annotation
  • Risk assessment or content safety annotation
  • Audio transcript annotation or audio-based data labeling
  • Named Entity Recognition or entity classification
  • LLM response evaluation
  • AI chatbot evaluation
  • Policy-based content moderation
  • Sensitive content classification
  • Gen AI or LLM training data creation

Candidates must have previously worked on annotation projects requiring strict guideline adherence, ambiguity resolution, and quality-focused decision-making.


Skills and Competencies

We are looking for candidates who have:

  • Excellent listening comprehension and audio interpretation ability in their working language.
  • Strong analytical thinking and decision-making skills.
  • A close attention to detail and consistency.
  • Ability to interpret complex, evolving guidelines and apply them accurately.
  • Comfort working with sensitive, ambiguous, or policy-heavy audio content.
  • Strong understanding of tone, context, and language nuance as conveyed through speech.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote, flexible-hours setup.
  • Familiarity with annotation tools, quality workflows, and productivity tracking.
  • Good communication skills for raising clarifications, documenting edge cases, and collaborating with distributed teams.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree, diploma, or equivalent educational qualification preferred.
  • Minimum 1–2 years of relevant annotation experience in AI/ML, Gen AI, audio data, content moderation, PII, risk assessment, or related domains.
  • Prior experience working on Large Language Model training, evaluation, or data annotation projects is strongly preferred.
  • Exposure to audio-based workflows, trust and safety operations, or privacy-focused annotation will be an advantage.


Engagement Terms

  • This is a freelance, non-binding engagement — there is no guaranteed or fixed weekly hour commitment on either side.
  • Work volume and availability windows will be communicated on a project/task basis, with flexibility for both iMerit and the freelancer to scale up or down.
  • Compensation is structured on a per-hour basis, aligned to project pricing terms, rather than a fixed salary.
  • Freelancers are expected to maintain agreed quality and turnaround standards for the tasks they accept.


What We Offer

  • Flexible, remote freelance opportunity with global project teams.
  • Exposure to cutting-edge Gen AI and LLM data annotation projects.
  • Opportunity to work on meaningful AI safety, privacy, and model improvement initiatives.
  • Structured project guidelines, quality support, and continuous learning opportunities.
  • A collaborative environment focused on precision, accountability, and responsible AI development.


Application Note

This role is suitable for candidates who are highly analytical, quality-focused, and comfortable working with complex audio annotation guidelines on a flexible, freelance basis. Bilingual proficiency is not required. Prior experience in PII, risk assessment, audio annotation, or LLM evaluation is essential.

title: R&D Documentation Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para R&D Documentation Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About the Role

Kor Nutra is seeking a detail-oriented R&D Documentation Specialist to support our nutraceutical gummy research and development team. This role is critical to ensuring our formulation records, testing documentation, and regulatory compliance materials meet the rigorous standards required in a GMP-regulated dietary supplement manufacturing environment. You'll work closely with R&D scientists, Quality, and Regulatory teams to maintain accurate, audit-ready documentation across new product development and formulation projects.


Key Responsibilities
  • Create, review, and maintain R&D documentation including formulation records, batch development reports, stability study documentation, and analytical testing records
  • Draft and revise Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), specifications, and technical protocols in support of new product development
  • Ensure documentation complies with 21 CFR Part 111 (Dietary Supplement cGMPs) and other applicable food/supplement regulations
  • Maintain version control and organization of R&D documents within document management systems
  • Support formulation IP documentation and ingredient traceability records
  • Collaborate with R&D, Quality, and Regulatory teams to prepare documentation for internal audits, customer diligence requests, and regulatory inspections
  • Translate technical/scientific data into clear, structured written documentation for cross-functional stakeholders
  • Assist in preparing technical write-ups for new product bids, formulation change requests, and label/claims substantiation files

    • Required Qualifications
    • Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Food Technology, Chemistry, Biochemistry, or a closely related scientific field
    • 2+ years of experience in a regulated food, dietary supplement, or pharmaceutical manufacturing environment
    • Hands-on experience with GMP documentation (batch records, SOPs, specifications, deviation/CAPA reports)
    • Strong technical writing skills with high attention to detail and accuracy
    • Working knowledge of 21 CFR Part 111 or equivalent regulatory frameworks
    • Proficiency with document control systems (QMS/eDMS) or highly organized file management practices
    • Strong Microsoft Office / Google Workspace skills
    • English-speaking


    Preferred Qualifications
    • Degree or coursework in Nutrition/Dietetics (a plus for label claims and nutrient substantiation work)
    • Experience specifically in gummy, confectionery, or nutraceutical/dietary supplement R&D
    • Familiarity with formulation software or LIMS (Laboratory Information Management Systems)
    • Experience supporting audits, customer diligence, or regulatory inspections
    • Exposure to ingredient traceability and supply chain documentation
    What We Offer
    • Competitive Compensation
    • Opportunity to work at the intersection of science and product innovation in a growing nutraceutical manufacturing company
    • Collaborative, fast-paced R&D environment with direct impact on product development

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Human Resources Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

If you live in Brazil, are fluent in English and want to build a global HR operation from scratch, we're looking for you!


About Downtown Engineers

Downtown Engineers (DWT ENG) is a New York-based MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) engineering firm trusted by architecture offices, developers and national brands. Our work spans from franchise rollouts for brands like McDonald's, Domino's and Dunkin' to hospitality projects with Hilton and Hyatt, healthcare and residential buildings across the United States.


We're a remote-first team of 30+ people across different countries, with 300+ projects delivered across 16+ sectors. Our culture is grounded in trust, transparency and autonomy — and that's what we want to nourish with our Human Resources.


About the Opportunity

You will be Downtown's first HR hire, reporting directly to one of the founding partners, with the mission of building the People function from scratch. Our operation is distributed by design across Brazil, the US and India. We have doubled our team in 2026 (now 30+) and will keep growing at a fast pace, with a People strategic plan already approved by the founders.


For the first 12 months, this role will mix orchestration and execution: you will coordinate specialized recruiting agencies in the US, Brazil and India; manage payroll and benefits; design and manage development programs in direct partnership with the leadership across the world.


One detail defines this role: your main internal clients are in the US and India. Interviews, trainings, sensitive career conversations and negotiations with American vendors will happen in English, every day.


Compensation & Structure

  • Full-time contractor (remote, based in Brazil)
  • Fixed monthly compensation
  • Please include your compensation expectation in BRL (R$) in your application


What you'll do (major challenges for 2026)

A. People Operations across 3 countries
